name: Peppermint King
description:
Position: Ruler Of Candy Village

Ruler of Candy Village, he is nearly 101 years old and has seven children living throughout the village. He is a jolly man with a factory raised high above the city. He often fights his brother the Sourpatch King for the thrown of the city with the help of the racers found throughout the Candy Lane Racing tournament.

name: Sourpatch King
description:
Position: Ruler Of Dark Licorice Forest

Brother to the Peppermint King, since his exile nearly a century ago by his parents, he has been on a vengeance to overthrow the Candy Village Kingdom. He often steals his nieces and nephews in an attempt to receive the thrown however his plans are always thwarted by the racers of the Candy Lane Tournament.

name: Crystal Vanillashake
description:
Position: Princess Of Candy Village

Daughter to the Peppermint King, she is set to become the new ruler when her father steps down. Although she is not a fan of her father and uncle’s feud. She supports her father because she knows he’s a good king. She lives in a crystal type house with many features including a giant garden of which racers uses as a racing court during the tournament.
affiliates: Peppermint King; Sourpatch King; Ron Coffeecake; Don Coffecake; Linda Lataffy

name: Honey Bear Children
description: A vast group of honey bears who live within the Candy Kane Forest. They are jolly creatures and always found smiling and dancing. They are the neighbors to the Sugarstorm Twins.

name: Sugarstorm Twins
description:
Position: Explorers

Collectors of old world items, they travel throughout the world collecting prize possessions and storing them. They are often considered the Candy Village’s explorers. They are appointed by Peppermint King to assist in finding priceless artifacts from the city’s ancient history.

name: Racer Red
description:
Position: Retired Candy Lane Racer

Dominant champion of the Candy Lane Races, he won nearly 100 years ago and serves now as the greatest racer of all times. Although many other racers won since then he won each lap and gained numerous points and rewards. He is of the Big Red family and loves spicy foods. Besides racing he loves to eat, often seeing eating really fast.
affiliates: Candy Lane Racers; Big Red Family

name: Big Red Family
description:
Position: Various

A group of fast talking people with red skin. Moving in fast motion often make others who are in their presence sick. Because of their enhance speed, they have been known everything from good racers, noble men and women, to thieves. Some say that they are descendants of the first Candy Lane Racer.

name: Mother Red
description: Stay at home mother, she is strong willed and very fast around the house.

name: Papa Red
description: Homemaker, he is very fast and talks in riddles. He is father to Racer Red and considered the original Racer Red although this isn’t yet revealed.

name: Sister Red
description: With long red locks. She is fast and beautiful. She loves fashion and everything is showcases. She is the owner of the town’s major shopping spot, Red’s Boutique.

name: Brother Red
description: Envious of his younger brother’s attention. He often tries to out do Racer Red at everything. Even going as far as sabotaging races that he is in. Although he loses. His pet cat is Red Kat.

name: Grandpa Red
description: Father to Mother Red. He is strong willed like his daughter. His long beard is the family’s signature red. His parents were war veterans who often raced for money.

name: Grandmother Pink
description: Papa Red’s mother, she is believed to be over 200 years old. She adores Grandpa Red with many believing that they are married. She owns a pink convertible with Big Red Gum serving as most of the vehicle.

name: Cousin Magenta
description: Cool talking cousin to the Big Red Family. His past and birthplace is unknown. But it is believed that he arrived in Candy Village in search of something.

name: Baby Red
description: The youngest of the family. Faster than the other members including Racer Red. Many wonder if he will be the next Racer Red. For now many are unaware of his special abilities to control the wind.

name: First Racer
description:
Position: Former Racer

Once a great racer, the First Racer whose name is unknown is considered the racing God to many of Candy Land Villagers. He or she always wore a suit and helmet to disguise themselves from the public. Since the tenth ever race, the First Racer never raced again with reasons left unknown. By the time the eleventh race started, the First Racer has left with no sign of return.

name: Red Kat
description:
Position: Assistant To Brother Red

A smart talking cat and pet to Brother Red. He assists in Brother’s Red plot to defeat his brother Racer Red. Although they are foiled each time. Unbeknownst to almost everyone, Red Kat is a devious mastermind who can speak, come up with scientific equations, and has the power to turn invisible. Among other talents including his talent of cooking and creating weapons for Brother Red’s vehicle. Also at times he participates in racing whenever Brother Red is absent. His cover has never been blown, although the Coffeecake brothers suspect his behavior.

name: Don Coffeecake
description:
Position: Chef

A fellow chef, he is plump and wears an outfit similar to a chef attire. He is in love with Crystal Vannillashake and races for her affection. Although smarter than his younger brother Ron, he loses against his brother at almost everything. He is an excellent racer and chef and loves to challenge others regardless of their stance or title. He plays the iconic hero role because of his desire for justice.

name: Ron Coffeecake
description:
Position: Chef

A jolly and happy go lucky person with a big sense of humor often seen laughing at random things and moments. He is younger than his brother although taller and better at almost everything than his brother. He also is an excellent racer while also being a good chef.

name: Linda Lataffy
description:
Position: Student At Candyhill High

Sister to Tiffany LaTaffy. She is nice unlike her sister and is a straight A student. She has long green hair and has a liking toward Ron Coffeecake.

name: Tiffany Lataffy
description:
Position: Cheerleader At Candyhill High

Cheerleader of Candyhill High, she is stuck up and is the mean girl in school. She hangs out with China Stoneberry and Cookie Cutterhill.
affiliates: Linda Lataffy; China Stoneberry; Cookie Cutterhill

name: China Stoneberry
description:
Position: Mean Girl At Candyhill High

One of the mean girls in school, unknown by many, she is a skilled baker and loves to cook. She has a thing for Racer Red, she has all of his memorabilia.

name: Cookie Cutterhill
description:
Position: Mean Girl At Candyhill High

She is one of the mean girls in school, she is very smart and loves to dance and sing which she showcases on many occasions. She also has a passion for racing of which she does and even goes as far as competing against Tiffany LaTaffy.

name: Van Vanillashake
description:
Position: Wealthy Businessman

Ex-husband to Crystal Vanillashake, the two broke up because of Van’s love of racing of which he does whenever he gets the opportunity to. He has said that nothing matters more than racing, often infuriating Crystal.

name: ICY McICECREAM
description:
Position: Wealthy Businesswoman

A cold and chilly tempered woman living in a house made of freezer burned ice cream and harden ice cream cones. She owns the town banks and is a very wealthy woman.

name: Goodie Goodbar
description:
Position: Town’S Mechanic

The towns mechanic, he owns a mechanic shop and is always seen working on cars including the ones used by racers. He is the one who installs the props in racer cars.

name: Chip Chocolatechip
description:
Position: Inventor

Overly confident inventor, he is a teenager who is always talking and always chipper. His ancestors were great inventors and help build the Chocolate Factory. So he tries to live up to their repetition however most of his inventions backfire.

name: Giggly Gumdrop
description:
Position: Racer, Student At Candyville Middle School

A valiant racer, always happy and full of energy. She is the youngest racer and has since been its price champion. She is covered in different candy products and smells like gumdrops. She lives in a house made completely out of lollipops and bubblegum.

name: Bebe Bubblegum
description:
Position: Racer

A firecracker, BeBe is blue haired and a great racer, she speaks her mind and is always seen blowing bubbles.

name: Kemberlie Kool-Aid
description:
Position: Pro Surfer

A laid back surfer girl with little care about anything but lounging and drinking Kool-Aid products. Her favorite past time other than laying back and relaxing is surfing which she always wins the surfing contests.

name: Brian Butterscotch
description:
Position: Sports Player

Local sports hero, loved by all the females, hated by most of the men, adored by his fans and followers. He is a price possession of the Candy Village however loses every Candy Lane race to Racer Red much to his disgust.

name: Jimmy Jawbreaker
description:
Position: Pro Boxer

A proud man known for his fast talking ways, he is thin with a large jawbreaker for a head. He is also a professional boxer. Appearing in many of the town’s various sport matches against various opponents. He owns a race car although he never raced and has no desire to. With others wondering its purpose for him. It is revealed that there is a secret behind the car.

name: Candice Caramel
description:
Position: Writer For The Candy Village Newspaper

A writer for the Candy Village Newspaper, she knows the latest on the latest found throughout the city. She is often the gossip queen of the city.

name: Gummybear Click
description:
Position: City’S Gang

A group of racers who are also the city’s gang. Although they appear lovable and jolly they are also bad news. They are minions of the Sugarpatch King.

name: Cindy Cinnamon
description:
Position: Singer

A beautiful singer who catches the ears of anyone who turns on the radio. She is a pop singer and the city’s music idol.

name: Bingo Butterman
description:
Position: City’S Artist

A quick thinking artist who uses his buttery skin to draw beautiful works of art. He is the city’s artist.

name: Stevie Shortcake
description:
Position: Town’S Hero

Appearing similar to a strawberry shortcake, he is a nice young man with a fighting attitude. He is the hero type and has since played such a part in his home town Candystone Shortcake.

name: Glinda Gummyworm
description:
Position: Teacher At Candyville Middle School

She is a glowing gummyworm who serves as a teacher at Candyville Middle School. She is often the voice of reason for Giggly Gumdrop.

name: Lance Licorice
description:
Position: Student At Candy Village High

Snobby short teenager with licorice skin. With most of the town’s money in his family’s vault. His family is the wealthiest in the world. He attends CANDY HILL HIGHand is dislike by almost everyone including the teachers because of his attitude. Although he doesn’t notice and just assumes everyone likes him.

name: Princess Candyshack
description:
Position: Princess Of Candystone Shortcake

Princess of a nearby village known as Candystone Shortcake. She has long flowing pink hair and pale skin. Her skin feels like butter and she smells like milk. Her dress and entire outfit is a collection of cakes. She carries a purse and wand which can omit magical properties. She is the love interest to Stevie Shortcake.

name: Mother Goodwill
description:
Position: Town’S Advisor & Physic

The town’s elder advisor and physic. She has an office covered in golden gumdrops and hard nuts. Although she is very polite, it has been shown that she is very dangerous and possibly a witch in disguise.

name: Snickrom
description:
Position: Town’S Former Ruler
Note: GOD OF CANDY VILLAGE

Often considered the God that resides over Candy Village. Although there are no confirmation of this story. It is said that he is as old as the world and has only been seen long enough for someone to witness his great power. After he stepped down as ruler over Candy Village, he disappeared. Now he only appears during great conflict.

name: Binny Blueberry
description:
Position: Student At Candyville Middle School

A young professional sports player. He attends school with Giggly Gumdrop and Ruby Redberry. At times he and Ruby go on scavenges to unlock secrets of the town.

name: Ruby Redberry
description:
Position: Student At Candyville Middle School

An inspiring detective. She takes after her father Royce Redberry who is the town’s detective. His mother disappeared when she was young which caused her to go into her father’s field. Although she is very young and attends middle school with Binny Blueberry and Giggly Gumdrop. It doesn’t stop her from adventuring around town to unlock secrets.

name: Royce Redberry
description:
Position: Town’S Detective

The town’s detective that went into the business to find his missing wife. He believes that there is a dark secret within in the town. He will do anything to unlock this secret.

name: McDee MOONPIE
description:
Position: Town’S Sheriff

The town’s sheriff and sworn enemy to Royce Redberry.

name: Gary Greenapple
description:
Position: Town’S Doctor

The town’s doctor, his pale blueskin and smell of sour lemons. Causes him to be turned away by most. That is until they realize that he is the most skilled doctor in town.

name: Royetta Redberry
description: Wife to Royce Redberry and mother to Ruby Redberry. She went missing during the great Candydrop storm which nearly destroyed the town. Believed to be alive, her husband will do anything to find her. She is the often reason behind quest during the Detective Race Games.

name: Honest Honeycomb
description:
Position: Reporter At Candy Rain Tv

Reporter of Candy Rain TV News, she is as her name applies very honest and will do anything to find a good story.

name: Charles Chocolatesnap
description:
Position: Student At Candydrop College, Swimmer

A teenager that attends Candydrop College. He has short gold hair with white streaks. He talks in a surfer slang and is a ladies man. With a passion for swimming. He is the self-appointed town’s greatest swimmer.

name: Cameraman Cookie
description:
Position: Cameraman At Candy Rain Tv

He is a walking cookie wearing a hat and always with his camera. Shooting everything he sees, he often annoys people because of his constant shooting of them. He is bullied and pushed around by Honest although he likes it as he likes her.

name: Cocoa Butterton
description:
Position: Student At Candydrop College

A fashionable diva who loves clothing, shopping, and boys. Whether it’s in that exact order is up for interpretation. She attends Candydrop College.

name: The Gummybear Citizens
description:
Position: Town’S People

Citizens of Candy Village, they come in different shapes, sizes, and colors and ranges in the millions.

name: Gingerbread Workers
description:
Position: Chocolate Factory

A group of workers with different shapes and sizes working at the Chocolate Factory. They sing and are choreograph dancers as well and happily serve the Peppermint King.

name: Gramcracker Citizens
description:
Position: Various

Similar in appearance to the Gingerbread Workers, these citizens are proud Upper Class members of Candy Village. They live near the Chocolate Factory.

name: Marshmallow Man
description:
Position: Owner Of Factories

A giant that lives at the edge of Marshmallow Post. He owns a range of factories and makes cars for racers of the Candy Lane Races. His children are known as the Smore Kids.

name: Ms. Choco Chocolate
description:
Position: Mother To The Smore Kids

Mother of the Smore Kids, she is sweet and fun loving and wife to the Marshmallow Man. She is a dancer and often teaches the citizens of Candy Village various dances.

name: Smore Kids
description:
Position: Children To Ms. Choco Chocolate & Marshmallow Man

Playful and sometimes spiteful children who are part marshmallow and part chocolate and resembles gummybears. They range in height and weight and are always seen in the form of threes.

name: Chocolate People
description:
Position: Various Workers At Marshmallow Man’S Factories

Made completely of chocolate, these group of citizens live on Marshmallow Post and range in various sizes including Dark Chocolate, Caramel, Swiss Cocoa, and Regular Chocolate.

name: Vanilla People
description:
Position: Council Of Order For Candy Village

Made completely of vanilla, these group of citizens live on Marshmallow Post, they are creamy filled and are stuck up to those around them. They believe in politics and serve as the Council of Order for Candy Village.

name: Marshmellows
description:
Position: Various

Are people made completely of Marshmallows, they range in sizes and are always jolly and very resourceful. Like the Vanilla & Chocolate People, they are giants and live on Marshmallow Post surrounding Candy Village.

name: Justin Jellybean
description:
Position: Town’S Author

The town’s author, his books has been read by almost all of Candy Village’s residents. He often writes for various newspapers and has a slight crush on Candice Caramel. Although he dislikes her constant gossiping.

name: Wendy Werther
description:
Position: Student At Candydrop College

Appearing similar to the famous Werther’s original. Her orange body is sticky and she is round. Jolly and usually seen laughing. She attends Candydrop College and has a crush on Charles Chocolatesnap

name: Nick & L Ni
description: Two children who are believe to be ghost of the town. Resembling walking versions of the candy Nik L Nips. They are mischievous children who disappears as quickly as they appear.

name: Cindy Peanut
description:
Position: Ringleader Of A Circus

Resembling a walking circus peanut, she is the ringleader of a traveling Circus of candies who visits Candy Village each year.

name: Sharon Sugardaddy
description:
Position: Owner Of A Popular Restaurant

The town’s chef, she has her own restaurant which serves as a popular destinations for students of CANDY HILL HIGHand Candydrop College.

name: Popper Rockstone
description: Self-acclaim rockstar, with his great singing voice. He could be one however his constant over the top personality stops him.

name: Perez Pez
description:
Position: Student At Candyville Middle School

Student at Candyville Middle School, he wears shorts and a different funny t-shirt each day. Shaped like the Pez candy. He is a jokester and bestfriend to Giggly Gumdrop.

name: Nico Neccowafer
description:
Position: Town’S Pharmacist

Tall resident to Candy Village, he is the town’s pharmacist and close friend to the town’s doctor, Gary Greenapple.

name: Punky Pockyridge
description:
Position: Bully/Student At Candyville Middle School

Shaped like the Japanese candy Pocky. He is a punkster and is bully at school. His known enemy is Giggly Gumdrop who beats him at everything. It is revealed that he has a crush on Giggly.

name: Vonna Vine
description:
Position: Inspiring Actor & Student At Candy Hill High

Daughter to Robert Vine the town’s award winning actor. Like her father she has a passion for acting and art. She attends Candy Village High. She also is a singer. Her direct arch rival is Cindy Cinnamon.

name: Robert Vine
description:
Position: Actor

With a valiant career in acting, Robert has inspired his daughter to become whatever she wants when she grows up. She chose to become an actor which made him proud. Proud enough that he made a movie about her.

name: Jill Jolly
description:
Position: Gym Teacher At Candyville Middle School

Over excited gym teacher at Candyville Middle School. Students play pranks on her which she overlooks as their affection for her.

name: Trouble Toblerone
description:
Position: Town’S Thief

Leader of the Gummybear Click. He sits out most of their missions because of his distinct look. It is said that he is responsible for most if not all of Candy Village’s robberies.

name: Mr. Smarty
description:
Position: Science Teacher At Candy Village High

Resembling the Smarts candy. Mr. Smarty is the slow talking science teacher at CANDY HILL HIGHthat always puts students to sleep. He talks so slow that he puts himself to sleep half way through a speech.

name: Milton Milkeyd
description:
Position: Math Teacher At Candy Village High

Milton has a milk dud head. He is filled with chocolate and cream which shows whenever he cries. Crying at random moments for different occasions. Milton is the Math Teacher at Candy Village High

name: Perry Pixie
description:
Position: Announcer At Races

With a long slim body, Perry Pixie is a pixie stick. He spills out sugar whenever he laughs or is excited. He is loud and serves as the perfect announcer at everything from races to other events.

name: Bina The Ballerina Pop
description:
Position: Ballet Instructor

Bina is a blowpop like no other. With her ever changing colored outfits. She is always ready to dance mostly in the form of ballet. Instead of walking she bounces up and down.

name: Johnson Milkyway
description:
Position: Host At The Candy Village Theme Park

Resembling a Milky Way bar, Johnson host numerous rides at the Candy Village’s biggest theme park.

name: Ricky Krispie
description: Ricky is a rice Krispy treat with attitude. He was once a part of the town’s gang. Until he supposedly went straight. However, he reverts back to his old habits serving as the town’s Robin Hood.

name: Karina Cotton
description: Karina Cotton is fluffy and dresses, sounds, and act like a southern bell. With her fluffy cotton candy dress and her big hair. She is the envy of all the town’s men.

name: Ruth
description:
Position: Baseball Player

Ruth is the town’s greatest baseball player. He plays the game of Marbles which is the equivalent to baseball in Candy Village. He is known as far as Food Town on the other side of the world. In his downtime, he likes to play Golf which is called Fuzz.

name: Almondo John
description:
Position: Janitor

Resembling an Almond Joy, Almondo is the janitor of many things. He could be at school or just around an area cleaning. His house is filled with old forgotten candy. When he is working he doesn’t smile, but when he is at home he is never known not to smile.

name: Reese Cupe`
description:
Position: Flight Captain

Resembling a round Reese’s cup. He is the proud captain of the SS Wonka, one of the planes that takes passengers to distant lands. His frequent destination is Food Town which bridges the two places together. He speaks with a deep French accent and is often mistaking for Pepe` when the two aren’t seen.

name: George Pay
description:
Position: Co-Captain

Resembling a payday bar. With giants nuts around his body. George is usually caught sneezing. Which releases salt and sugar into the air causing others to sneeze after him. He can be seen as a frequent captain aboard the SS Wonka. He is also a frequent patient to Gary Greenapple.

name: Starry Burst
description:
Position: Flower Shop Owner

Cheery multicolored starburst girl Starry Burst. Is a dynamic flower shop owner who can burst out in a musical at any given moment. Although she cannot sing, she enjoys it and amuses and annoys everyone that comes into her shop.

name: Pepe`
description:
Position: Boat Owner

Resembling Peeps candy, Pepe` has a strong French accent. He is flamboyant and dresses like a fashionista. He can be seen on occasion with marshmallow like birds flying around him.

name: Monty Junior
description:
Position: Computer Tech

Resembling Junior Mints. Monty loves technology. Often installing advance gadgets in homes and fixing things that are related to technology. He is also the silent type unless a topic of technology comes up.

name: Tootsie
description:
Position: Ballet Instructor

Arch Rival to Bina the Ballerina Pop. She owns a dance studio opposite of Bina’s. When she open the two has since been at odds. Often fighting to get students. She appears in different colored outfits opposite of the colors of Bina.

name: Shumway Skit
description:
Position: Owner Of The Haircut Shop

Appearing in multiple colors at times like the skittles he resembles. The S on his chest is often mistaken for a super hero type design. Although he constant reverts to it only being his name. He is the town’s vet.

name: Cadburry Eggstrom
description:
Position: Owner Of The Egg Shop

With half of his body a tasty sweet egg. Cadburry is the topic of jokes. Although a very wealthy man and owner of the Egg Shop. Cadburry enjoys his time alone because of the constant joking.

name: Franklin La Fish Bula`
description:
Position: Music Teacher At Candy Hill High

A Swedish man resembling the Swedish Fish candy. He waddles and talks in rhymes. He sings and brings on a musical throughout the town.

name: Pepper York
description:
Position: One Of The Candy Lane Racers

Resembling a York Peppermint Patty. Pepper is hot headed with a scent of mint. She gets easily angered and shows it during races. Her good points are that she will try not to get road rage while racing against others. Although this has never happen.

name: Kitty Kat Kat
description:
Position: One Of The Candy Lane Racers

Kitty is one of the racers of Candy Lane Racers. Moving to Candy Village, Kitty has been on a search for something mysterious.

name: Hilda Hershey
description:
Position: One Of The Candy Lane Racers

Hilda is daughter to two acrobatic instructors whom are never seen. Flexible herself, Hilda loves racing and is one of the constant players of Candy Lane Racers

name: Brinda Butterfin
description:
Position: Town’S Lawyer

Brinda is a Butterfinger with spunk. She loves fixing other people’s problems and even helping to represent them. She is the town’s lawyer and very good at her job. Her law firm represents racers who are sued for their conduct on the field.

name: Candy Collina Corn
description:
Position: Town’S Farmer

Candy owns a large patch of candy corn growing on the West side of Candy Village. Since candy corn is used in almost all dishes of Candy Village’s resident’s food. She is their living hope for good and consistent food.

name: Twizzy
description:
Position: Town’S Dj

Twizzy is the town’s DJ. He loves music and with his multicolored dreads. He is the island sounding guy who is never seen with a musical instrument.

name: Sanders The Sneeky Snik
description:
Position: Retail Associate & One Of The Candy Lane Racers

Sanders is a snicker bar that can be anywhere in a flash. He moves in the shadows and causes havoc wherever he goes. However, it is a time when he could be good when working for his dear employer at the Cady Strip Mall.

name: Molly M&M
description:
Position: One Of The Candy Lane Racers

Molly is a round M&M with changing personalities. The color of her body changes to match her different personalities. Although, her personality can be anything from a delight to a fright. She is one of the favorite Candy Lane Racers. Her car and weapons changes to match her mood.

name: The Kisses
description:
Position: Various

Hundreds of small Hershey kisses that live down in the valley on the east side of Candy Village. They work together and come in numerous flavors of chocolate. They are associate with Hilda Hershey because her parents, whom are traveling acrobatic instructors. Help built their town.

name: Adam Atomic
description:
Position: Ski Instructor

Resembling the Atomic Fireball. Adam’s head is always red with him receiving frequent headaches. He takes his pain out on the slopes in the far North part of Candy Village.

name: Carl Sigereo
description:
Position: Candy Village (South Side)

Often seen smoking candy cigarettes. He feels his surroundings with sweet scents that turns into bad scents if he smokes too long. He is the town’s gardener.

name: Del Ana Sweets
description:
Position: One Of The Candy Lane Racers

One of the Candy Lane Racers, she is bubbly and smell likes all sorts of candies. She is very skilled at racing and fixes her own car. Her weapon of choice is the gumball cannon.

name: Randy Pieces
description:
Position: Astrologer

An astrologer that spends his time looking into the stars. He has a small body but big dream. He stays on the East Side of Candy Village near the Keteer Brothers.

name: Athos Keteer
description:
Position: Factory Worker

One of the Keteer Brothers, like his brothers he resembles a Three Musketeer bar. He is not the smartest of his brothers, often plays jokes on them and insults them. With Porthos usually being the end of his jokes the most.

name: Porthos Keteer
description:
Position: Milk Deliverer

Milk driver, he is liked by the town’s people more than his other brothers. Like his brothers he resembles a Three Musketeer bar. He is quiet and easily intimidated.

name: Aramis Keteer
description:
Position: School Bus Driver

He is the oldest of his brothers and usually fights for control of them with his brother D’artagnan. He drives the town’s school bus and can be seen flirting with Kemberlie Kool-aid whenever hes at the beach.

name: D’Artagnan Keteer
description:
Position: A Part Of The Candy Hill Highguard

During his time as a youth, D’artagnan left for a faraway land where he returned with a slight French accent. He is good friends with Pepe’ having met him in this land before. He is one of the guards of the CANDY HILL HIGHGuard. The protective government of the town. He is the leader of Keteer brothers something he fights with his brother Aramis. Like his brothers he resembles a Three Musketeer bar.

name: Willy
description:
Note: THE GOD OF CHOCOLATE

One of the numerous deities of Eliverse. He has long black hair, numerous candies around him. His loyal servants are the numerous candies of Candy Village. He holds a power item that many are on a mysterious mission to find. It is said that this item can grant very powerful results. Since the fall of the gods in the Eliverse, he has only been during great devastation throughout Candy Village.

name: Hamilton Burginton
description:
Position: Mayor

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: HAMBURGER

Mayor of Food Town, Hamilton Burginton is a proud man with lots of love for his residents. Before being the Mayor of Food Town, Hamilton was a member of the Cross Country Debate which shares information and debates between Candy Village and Food Town.

name: Carl Cardon
description:
Position: Car Dealer

RESIDENT OF: SWEETS VALLEY

FOOD RELATION: DONUT

Carl Cardon whose last name is a play on the fact that he is a car dealer and also a donut. He is the ultimate salesman, trying to sell any type of car in any type of condition. He is loud and argues almost completely to everyone except his wife. He tries his best to run for mayor although he has never succeeded. He has an Italian accent and talks like a member of the mafia with his Donutmen being his henchmen. His ultimate goal is to take over Food Town at any price.

name: Mary Peanutelly
description:
Position: School Teacher

RESIDENT OF: SWEETS VALLEY

FOOD RELATION: PEANUT & JELLY

Mary is a proper English school teacher. Her love for art and anything dealing with crafts. Have gotten her into numerous contests and she serves as the spokesperson for anything dealing with events. On average she has taught almost every resident of Food Town at least once. Her body is of a peanut while her hair is made up of jelly.

name: Sarah Sausagehead
description:
Position: Local Barber

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: SAUSAGE

Sarah is sister to Benjamin Biscuit. She is the town’s local barber. She also provides advices to anyone who sits in her chair. Strings of mustard serves as her hair.

name: Tina Tunahow
description:
Position: Swim Instructor

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: TUNA

Located near the banks of Food town, Tina is the town’s local swim instructor. She lives in a well decorated tuna can and moves with the sea to give lessons to people located alongside the beach.

name: Little Salmon
description:
Position: Children To Siegfried Seaford

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: SALMON

Children to Siegfried Seaford, they are salmon who frolic throughout the port. They each have different colors and aren’t known apart. With even Sigfreed confusing them at time.

name: Siegfried Seaford
description:
Position: Local Fisherman & Owner Of Fishing Range

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: BASS

Siegfried Seaford is the town’s best fisher. He owns a popular fishing range off the town’s port. He looks like a giant bass and has children who look like salmon.

name: Chip Cheezor
description:
Position: Town’S Doctor

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: CHIP & CHEESE

Chip Cheezor is a Latin speaking doctor who has come all the way from another part of the world. He is the town’s local doctor and works at the town’s largest hospital.

name: China Cherrywood
description:
Position: Town’S Pharmacist

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: CHERRY

China Cherrywood is the town’s local pharmacist. She loves what she does and helping others. Although she doesn’t like to see anyone sick. She herself has an acute sickness that no one knows about.

name: Samual Sas
description:
Position: Town’S Healer

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: SASQUATCH

Samual Sas is a Persian speaking Sasquatch that arrived to Food Town from overseas. He has the skill to heal others and has since been considered the town’s local healer. He also assists the town’s local pharmacist in providing healing regimens.

name: Fenley Fruitcake
description:
Position: Fashion Designer

RESIDENT OF: SWEETS VALLEY

FOOD RELATION: FRUITCAKE

Fenley is a flamboyant college student visiting Food Town. He has been known for some time to be the most sought out up and coming fashion designer. He loves fashion even going to the lengths of working with several designers across the world to perfect his own designs.

name: Chad Crum
description:
Position: Student/ Bike Shop Associate

RESIDENT OF: SWEETS VALLEY

FOOD RELATION: CRUM OF A COFFEECAKE

Chad Crum is a biker and works at the local bike shop in town. He has the personality of the typical high schooler. With only love for video games and explosions.

name: Penny Pizzaroll
description:
Position: Waitress

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: PIZZA ROLL

A skating champion, Penny loves her job being a waitress. She studies at Expresso High and is bestfriends with Chad Crum.

name: Tim Tamoto
description:
Position: Student

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: TAMATO

A fellow book worm that attends the town’s middle school. His knowledge expands that of normal middle school students. When asked why he wouldn’t want to be placed in high school. His response was simple. “I would rather play with others my age instead studying with others that are not.”

name: Paul Porterhouse
description:
Position: Firefighter

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: STEAK

Paul along with his fellow associates, is one of the many who protects the town from harm such as fires in his case. He runs the unit which covers fires and outburst in town.

name: Benjamin Buscuit
description:
Position: Computer Tech

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: BUSCUIT

A grumpy computer technician that fixes most of the town’s local electronics. His brother is the town’s electrician while his sister is the town’s local plumber. Although they are different forms of food, they were born together.

name: Mr. Harold Hotdog
description:
Position: Lawyer

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: HOT DOG

One of the town’s most reputable lawyers. Harold speaks in an Asian accent and uses his world traveling experiences to represent his clients in a formidable matter. He wears a pocket watch and a one eyed cover glass.

name: Ms. Cupcakepiton
description:
Position: Richest Woman In Sweets Valley

RESIDENT OF: SWEETS VALLEY

FOOD RELATION: CUPCAKE

A loud laughing cupcake looking woman who lives in the most prestigious neighborhood in Sweets Valley. She owns several estates and talk in a snobby rich 17th century English voice.

name: Lidia Letuchah
description:
Position: Airport Worker

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: LETTUCE

Lidia Letuchah is a Hispanic firecracker. With attitude and sass to match. She comes from the islands and works at the town’s airport.

name: Tonya Thanving
description:
Position: Local Dress Shop Owner

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: TURKEY THIGH

Tonya Thanving is a wholesome woman. She is proud and has a thing for summer days. Owner of a local dress shop, Tonya gives frequent advice to locals about how to dress even if they don’t ask.

name: Chancellor Chickenbroth
description:
Position: Chancellor

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: CHICKEN LEG

Chancellor Chickenbroth is the town’s chancellor. He is old and wise and has a deep southern accent. His long robes signals power. Power that not even the Mayor dares to stand up against

name: Donald Donutmaker
description:
Position: Police Officer

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: DONUT

Donald is a police officer who despises being one. Mostly because the other guys on the force looks at him with the thoughts of turning him into a snack. To disturb this thought he brings them other delicious morsels.

name: Iris Icewell
description:
Position: Bank Retailer

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: ICE CREAM

Iris is the snappy bank tailor with a British Accent and New Yorker attitude. She has long nails and sits daily behind a glass window at the town’s local bank. She has the hots for Craig Creamcake mostly because he is a businessman.

name: Winslow Whipportae`
description:
Position: Theme Park Worker

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: WHIPCREAM

Winslow is a chill associate who works at the local theme park. He assists customers on rides and at times can be seen dancing to his headphones.

name: Carla Creamcake
description:
Position: Bakery Assistant

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: CAKE

Carla Creamcake is the wife to Craig Creamcake. She is tall and has dough for hair. She loves to bake and runs her family’s establishment when Craig is away. Otherwise she uses her spare time to make secret cakes for someone very special to the town.

name: Craig Creamcake
description:
Position: Bakery Owner

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: CAKE

Craig Creamcake is the town’s baker. He uses special herbs to spice up his desserts while also making desserts named after famous celebrities. His bakery is the largest and most famous out of Food Town.

name: Kelly Ketchup
description:
Position: Crime Lord

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: KETCHUP

Fast talking ace of Carl Cardon’s mafia group. She has long red hair and is shaped like a ketchup bottle. She uses her looks to get her and the gang into numerous high profile places. She talks with a strong New Yorker accent.

name: Michael “Money” Mustard
description:
Position: Crime Lord

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: MUSTARD

One of the gang member’s part of Carl Cardon’s mafia group. Thinking about money at all times, he was released from prison just before it burned down. With him being the prime suspect. He is a most wanted criminal and works from his safe haven near the docks of Food Town.

name: Monty Mayonaise
description:
Position: Swim Club Owner & Mafia Member

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: MAYONAISE

One of the gang member’s part of Carl Cardon’s mafia group. He is the brains behind most of the operations often seen talking to Carl about plans to take over the city. When he is by himself he enjoys swimming and runs a swimming club at the edge of town overlooking the beach.

name: Sonya Spaghetti
description:
Position: Dance Instructor

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: SPAGHETTI

A skilled dancer and teacher at the local dance studio. Her stringy body allows her to do numerous dance styled techniques including ballet. Sonya has a deep southern accent and smells like sauce.

name: Ricky Rice
description:
Position: Runner At Expresso High

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: RICE

Running track for Expresso High. He is the closest friend to Ellis Éclair. His dreams is to be a pro runner with already winning several gold medals. He has a scholarship to a major university.

name: Cindy Cuccumber
description:
Position: Student

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: CUCCUMBER

Cindy has a dull personality. Wearing glasses and launches an attitude when someone stares at her. She is usually quiet and reads a lot of books.

name: Luna Lasagna
description:
Position: Restaurant Owner

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: LASAGNA

Luna loves to cook, she uses her own special made sauces and always looks for inspiration to make a new dish. Her restaurant is the most famous in Food town.

name: Perry Pearrinnis
description:
Position: Singer

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: PEAR

Perry is the town’s award winning singer. Traveling to foreign places to perform his hits. He created the city’s theme song and plays it at major festivals. His attitude is similar to pop stars of the 1950s.

name: The Little Grapes
description:
Position: Children Of Gary Grapes

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: GRAPES

Children to Gary Grape, loud, obnoxious, and often considered brats. These children are the reasons behind Gary’s numerous headaches which he complains about. They come in different sizes and colors and each with a different personality. Although they look the same.

name: Gary Grape
description:
Position: Farmer

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: GRAPE

Gary Grape is a depressed farmer whose crops are always missing something. To his best of knowledge he can’t find out what. Although the town loves his fruit that he grows and the fact that the town depends on his crops. He is somewhat of a perfectionist and shows it through his constant reworking his farmlands.

name: Andrew Applington
description:
Position: Boat Owner

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: APPLE

Andrew is the wild child, he is brother to Anna Applington and was the suave guy with the ladies when he was young. He loved to play the guitar and sit on his twenty year old boat which he won gambling. He returned to Food town in search of something mysterious believing the mayor to have it.

name: Candice Cranberry
description:
Position: Teacher

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: CRANBERRY

Candice is close friends with Anna Applington. The two grew up together and has always been quite fond of teaching. With their classrooms side by side, the two usually chat with each other between lessons and during lunch. Candice is jolly and has a thing for Anna’s brother.

name: Anna Applington
description:
Position: Teacher

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: APPLE JUICE

A school teacher at the town’s middle school. Anna is called the nicest and yet strictness teacher at school. She loves to learn and to think of numerous things to share with her class. She is bright and loves her students.

name: Sunny Orangedelight
description:
RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: ORANGE JUICE

Sunny Orangedelight is bubbly and always seen in a sunny personality hence his name. He loves to whistle and dance whenever he can. His famous saying is “Life is like Oranges, you have to keep peeling until you get to the good stuff.”

name: Cary Coffee
description:
Position: Server

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: COFFEE

Cary is an artist who dreams of leaving Food Town for bigger locations although Food Town is the largest place in her region. She also loves to draw fantasy styled dresses and her perfect prince. She day dreams in public often at work.

name: Patty Pancake
description:
Position: Town’S Gossip

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: PANCAKE

Patty Pancake is one of the town’s biggest gossip, often providing the latest scoop to Dorma Dish. Patty is shaped like a pancake with chocolate for eyes and wears an apron. She loves to laugh and whisper. She lives in a syrup bottled styled house.

name: Dorma Dish
description:
Position: Reporter

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: FORK

The town’s reporter, Dorma has the scoop on everything within Food Town and Sweets Valley. She comes from a long line of reporters with a mural of her family over her fireplace. She is talkative often annoying others while also speaking really fast to the point where it makes people dizzy.

name: Petey Pie
description:
Position: Student At Expresso High

RESIDENT OF: SWEETS VALLEY

FOOD RELATION: PIE

Petey Pie is a sweet boy who loves to play musical instruments. He has two alter egos both of which are opposite completely of him. Whenever he becomes his rock and roll self he is wacky and only hangs with the hottest girls. When he is playing the piano he is relaxed and mellow. When normal he is the stereotypical hippy with a pie shaped boy.

name: Ellis Eclaire
description:
Position: Basketball Player At School

RESIDENT OF: SWEETS VALLEY

FOOD RELATION: éclair

Ellis Eclaire is a schoolboy that attends Expresso High. He is the school’s stereotypical basketball star. He is chocolate based and dark toned color and resemblance to a walking eclaire. He is also the star of many of the school’s games and usually is seen with screaming girls around him. He loves to smile, play basketball, eat, and sleep.

name: Petunia Pecania
description:
Position: Taxi Driver

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: PECAN

A kind taxi driver that interrogates individuals who gets inside of her taxi. Although she simply ask questions. She is usually very nosey and serves as a medium to her passengers.

name: Bobbie Berryworth
description:
Position: Train Operator

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: BLACKBERRY

After the building of the train system throughout Food Town. Bobbie was the first appointed train driver of the longest train route throughout Food Town.

name: Paris Perrycworth
description:
Position: Transit Authority Manager

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: PEACH

Pushing for the Food town Train Authority to be built. Since its creation, Paris has been appointed the authority figure over the trains and buses that runs throughout the town. He is a plump man like a peach.

name: Kiki Limepie
description:
Position: Bus Operator

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: KEY LIME PIE

A fun going bus driver in Food Town. She is everyone’s favorite bus driver and is an overly happy person. Her body is shaped just like a Key Limepie with the stereotypical African American Woman personality and voice.

name: Onya Onionspice
description:
Position: Chef

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: ONION

Onya is the town’s local chef. She owns several restaurants and is in talks to build several new ones in Candy Village across the bridge. Onya is one of the wealthiest people within Food town.

name: Peruth Patato
description:
Position: Architect

RESIDENT OF: FOOD TOWN

FOOD RELATION: POTATO

Originally from Fine China Islands, he has a distinct Caribbean accent. With French fries for hair, his outfit is that of a typical Reggae singer.

name: Huck Huckleberry
description:
Position: Council Member & Hunter

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: HUCKLEBERRY

Using his influences across the world, Huck is the prominent figure in town when it comes to legal matters. In his spare time he loves to hunt.

name: Patrick St. Popcorn
description:
Position: Theatre Owner

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: POPCORN

Patrick has a strong Irish accent and uses his background to make many movies which he plays in his popular theatre. His theatre is the most popular theatre out of the Fine China Islands.

name: Sherrie Strawberry
description:
Position: Herbologist

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: STRAWBERRY

Sherrie is the local Herbologist for Fine China Islands and Food town. She is a walking talking strawberry with a streak personality. With her passion for wild plants, she often could be seen talking to them.

name: Shonda Sweet
description:
Position: Student

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: SWEET POTATO

Shonda is a student at Fine China Islands Middle School. She is kind and the school’s valedictorian. Her goals are always set high because she only strives for the best in everything. A real go getter, Shonda uses her resources to complete task fully and on time.

name: Serena Sodapop
description:
Position: Student

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: SODA

Serena Sodapop is a bubbly student at Fine China Islands Middle School. She is daughter of Pep and Coka Sodapop.

name: Wallis Whoppie
description:
Position: COP

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: WHOOPIE PIE

The town’s best cop, Wallis enforces the law no matter of the situation. Believing that no one is above the law. Wallis uses most of his time sitting around eating donuts and enforces ridiculous rules to pedestrians.

name: Chingy Crabblue
description:
Position: Writer

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: BLUE CRABS

Chingy Crabblue speaks in a quiet Australian accent. Although not much is known about his past, he reveals a lot about his present through stories that he writes.

name: Smith Islandpie
description:
Position: Sports Director

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLAND

FOOD RELATION: SMITH ISLAND PIE

Smith Islandpie is Fine China Islands’ own sports chief. Whenever something sporty comes to the islands or when a major sport is taking place. He is there usually the one cheering or leading the team.

name: Monique Muffintop
description:
Position: Principal At Fine China Elementary School

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: CORN MUFFIN

Monique Muffintop is Fine China Islands’ principal of Fine China Elementary school. She reads a lot and hates disciplining children.

name: Kidman Kranberry
description:
Position: Sheriff

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: CRANBERRY

The local sheriff of Fine China Islands, Kidman Kranberry holds his badge high. He worships the law and upholds it at all cost.

name: Norman Navybean
description:
Position: Navy Seal Captain

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: BAKED NAVY BEAN

A navy seal, Norman Navybean speaks like a true general and is the most honest man you could meet. He loves to fish and has a strong bond with his fellow seals.

name: Brett Bostonpie
description:
Position: Businessman

RESIDENT OF: FINE CHINA ISLANDS

FOOD RELATION: BOSTON CREAM PIE

Brett Bostonpie is a wealthy businessman who uses his influence to build extravagant hotels across the Fine China Islands.

name: The Royal Guard
description: Riven Happenings

name: Prince of Mushroom Valley
description: Kohan Mushroom

name: Prince Faren
description:
Note: Prince of Fairy Village

Prince Faren is the handsome prince that has been placed in a terrible sickness and will die unless a cure is found.

name: Sir Will Castings
description: Love interest to Queen Annabelle. A cold hearted prince that only wants power. Once a good guy that developed a crush on Annabelle, he turned against her believing that she was in love with his brother.

name: Sir Walter Doogood
description: Half-brother to Sir Will Castings and loving natured compared to his older brother. Seen by many as the next ruler to Jerule. He moved away from the kingdom when his brother waged war against Queen Annabelle and her kingdom.

name: Sir Gallihad Mistakes
description: A clumsy king who is loving, intelligent, and very handsome however not a favorite amongst his people. He meets Princess Lurella who he abducts in order to protect her against an evil wizard bent on taking over her land. The two eventually falls in love.

name: Jon Lu Callihad
description: An evil wizard bent on taking over Princess Lurella’s kingdom and land from her. He uses a large size wand to abrupt time and space and steals things from different dimensions in order make himself more powerful.

name: The Laughing King
description: An honorable king that laughs at just about anything, a curse set on him by an angry deity from his past. He was transformed back into a kid and fell in love with Fairygood Weather.

name: Kelter
description: Servant to Jon Lu Callihad and his apprentice. He often performs powerful spells although fails at besting Callihad even though he tries to steal his wand. Although he breaks away from Callihad for a moment, he secretly adores him and just wants to prove himself worthy.

name: Princess of Dream World
description: Princess Riza is a young free-spirited girl who has long blue hair laced with pearls given to her by her mother. She is happy to support her parents for the coronation which she is about to be made the next queen after her mother steps down. However, things go wrong, and her parents go missing and it’s up to her to stop her evil aunt from taking the throne.

name: Princess Domina
description:
Note: Princess of Tower Central

Princess Domina is a red hair firecracker who knows what she wants and won’t stop till she gets it. Proud and humble at the same time. She is on a mission to awake her father who has been placed under a sleeping spell by her wicked stepmother. Domina must travel through Mushroom Valley to find a magical mushroom that will help awake her father so that they can overthrow her stepmother before it’s too late.

name: Princess of Fairytale City
description: Princess Fiarra is the next in line to take over the duties of a fairy godmother. She is smart and calculates everything she does. She meets a handsome prince who is sick and the two falls in love. As she is set for her own responsibilities, she must balance saving her one true love and to become the next fairy godmother.

name: Lady Antivail
description: A powerful sorceress that was turned back into a young girl who barely understands her abilities in an attempt by her evil uncle who also practices magic to gaining power over her kingdom.

name: Princess Cassandra
description: A popular blonde-haired girl with everything she has always wanted including next in line to become queen. However, a dance at her famous ball (ball of the century) turns her into a fighting warrior that must save her prince Akalen from being overthrown in his own kingdom.

name: Queen Annabelle
description: The youngest queen of her lineage. She inherited her thrown when her parents and older brother all were killed at sea. She developed a crush on her prince but found out that he was only after her thrown and now it is up to her to stop him or lose everything that is left of her family.

name: Impress Lurella
description: Beautiful, smart, and always up for something new. She loves animals and everything that glitters like gold. One day while out in her gardens, she is abducted which sends her kingdom into a frenzy trying to find her. Along the way the guy that abducts her turns out to be her one true love.

name: The Wicked Womena
description: A powerful witch that betrayed her one true love and has since dived into the darkest arts. Set to overthrow her niece Princess Riza and take over the future thrown of Dream Land.

name: Stepmother Golda
description: Bent on ruling her husband’s kingdom at any cost. She had an affair with her husband’s brother and while the brother was exile she remained after lying saying she was raped by him. Feeling sorry for him. King Odelion remained by her side and the two married a week later. Since she has been in love with power and grew into a wicked woman with desire to become sole power over the kingdom. However, her step daughter Princess Domina is the only thing standing in her way.

name: Enchantress Kina
description: Distant relative to the fairies, this evil Dark Fairy has made stories around her evil ways and now she is attempting to overthrow Fairytale City to become the most powerful and dominant fairy.

name: Mr. Zierre
description: Evil uncle to Lady Antivail. He is hellbent on taking over her kingdom and replacing his brother. It is later revealed that he is sick in the head and has attempts to slaughter his family just to get to the throne.

name: Fairygood Weather
description: Powerful fairy of the fourteen realms. She is the tallest fairy in Fairytale City and she uses her magic at times to prevent wars caused by those of which Fairytale City overlooks.

name: Ruby Rhinestone
description: Ruby Rhinestone is the main character of the Prehistoria stories. Born to a middle-class family, Ruby is smart, fast, and have shown to be very strong similar to other residents of Prehistoria. Her adventures around Prehistoria are the basis of the Prehistoria stories.

name: Abigale Diamond
description: Abigale is Ruby’s oldest friend and her closest ally. Her ancestors are responsible for prehistoric advances in technology including the wheel. Because of this, her family are some of the wealthiest and most inventive in Prehistoria. Her house is very large and while her family are the typical snobbish type, she is very down to earth.

name: Lightning Stardust
description: Stardust is a smart young android girl that hails from Adropia. One day her curious attitude led her to board her father’s experimental spacecraft. With it she crashes landed on a far away world shortly after coming cross the cosmic damage left by the Akuma. While stranded on Earth she lands in Ridlan City and befriends the Patricks.

name: Stuart Patrick
description: Stuart Patrick, close friend to Lightning Stardust and brother of Chloe Patrick, who gave her the name Lightning before her actual name because of her lightning bolt shaped hairstyle. He is a fan of the stars and wishes one day to visit another world.

name: Chloe Patrick
description: Chloe Patrick, close friend to Lightning Stardust and sister of Stuart Patrick. She is more steady head than her brother. One day she wants to be a detective and often helps Stardust on her mission to find a way back home.

name: Gale Stardust
description:
Title: Mayor of Ridlan City

A loving albeit stern mother of the Patrick children, wife of Lloyd Patrick, and mayor of Ridlan City. She hides from everyone outside of her family of Stardust true nature.

name: Vivienne Rachels
description: Nosey neighbor of the Patricks, she is often very curious of Stardust and even has her daughter spy on her at school.

name: Johanna Rachels
description: Daughter of Vivienne, she is just as suspicious of the Patricks and Stardust as her mother and together they spy on them.

name: Principal Taylor Arnold
description: Stern principal but loving of his students and staff. He often finds himself at odds with the Patrick children and Stardust because of their often rebellious and secretive nature.

name: PooPoo the Baby Dragon
description: PooPoo is a curious blue dragon that can freeze things with his wings. His family are revered amongst other dragon clans, however he tends to overlook this and befriend other baby dragons.

name: GoGo the Fire Dragon
description: GoGo the Fire Dragon is smart mouthed and fast, he is arrogant yet very loyal to his family and friends. He befriends PooPoo early in the PooPoo Baby Dragon story.

name: Vein the Water Dragon
description:
Title: Princess of the Water Dragons

Vein the Water Dragon is powerful to be a baby dragon. She is very popular and heir to dragon kingdom. She met with Aqua and befriended her. She is also friend to the other baby dragons.

name: Carus the Electric Dragon
description:
Title: Descendant of the Storm Dragons

Carus the Electric Dragon, he has a crush on Vein and is the first to protect her whenever possible danger is near. He is the descendant of the Storm Dragons and often can create storms when is in distress. He is friends to the other baby dragons.

name: Lady Spring
description:
Title: Spirit of Easter and Spring

Lady Spring is daughter to Santiyline and next in line to become Mother Nature. She guards spring and her children are the spirits of springtime including Easter.

name: Red Summer
description:
Title: Spirit of Freedom and 4th of July

Red Summer is a physical fit man who is the spirit of summertime and represents Fourth of July. He is strong and can emit fire. He is son of Vulkan.

name: Nicholas Claus
description:
Title: Santa Claus, Spirit of Christmas

Nicholas Claus is the spirit of Christmas and once shown the world his face before retreating to his home the North Pole. Here is more a sloth whose powers are weakened due to his brother.

name: Love Valentine
description:
Title: Spirit of Valentine’s Day

Love Valentine a beautiful spirit and daughter to Jessana. She is tall, has long red hair, and smells like cherries. She hovers over the ground and can cause any man to fall in love with her. She is often the annoyance of Autumn.

name: Mother Harvest
description: Mother of the harvest and powerful figure seen in ancient times. She is often seen as a young beautiful woman; however, she can also appear in another more wiser older form. Herself and Love Valentine, often are seen arguing with each other their respective beauty.

name: Pumpkin King
description:
Title: Spirit of Halloween

Father to Spitfire Pumpkin and son of Bewithia. He is a powerful warlock that created the holiday Halloween as a gift for his absent father Xshaun. He is brass, anxious, and hardheaded much like his son.

name: Baby New Year
description:
Title: Spirit of New Year

Baby Newyear is loving figure and believed child of Jesus. He is smart although seen as a cocky adolescence. If he dies, many ancient stories state that there will be a dark year ahead.

name: Jack Frost
description:
Title: Santa Claus Brother

One of the two brothers to Santa Claus, Jack is a powerful being capable of controlling ice particles in the air and is responsible for most of winter lasting longer if he is angered.

name: Krampus
description:
Title: Spirit of Bad Christmas

A disrespectful and distrustful spirit that steals gifts from children. His anger over the years grew worse after being denied the power of the Claus’. Because of his betrayal against the other spirits, he was banished to the Shadow Realm. The holiday stories follow the saviors attempting to stop him from ending all holidays.

name: Ms. Marienne Claus
description:
Title: Ms. Claus

Wife of Santa Claus, Ms. Marienne Claus is a proud elf that first met her husband during a winter’s ball thrown by his parents. Her powers are very strong and it is because of her for the reason creatures in the North Pole are magical.

name: Strawberry Darline
description:
Title: Baker

Strawberry Darline is a smart, fun loving, and friendly girl that can make almost anything. She built her own bakery and is the joy to Melody Hills. She has met with the residents of Food Town, Candylane Village, Prehistoria, and a glimpse of the Holiday Saviors battle.

name: Spitfire Pumpkin
description:
Title: Prince of Halloween

A carefree spirit that can controls souls. He is very curious of humans, so much so that he often travels to the human world to walk amongst them. He is the son of the Pumpkin King.

name: Julius Rains
description: A kid that often follows Spitfire Pumpkin along on his adventures. He is an orphan and often dreams of traveling to another world.

name: Maggie Stonewell
description: A curious kid that follows Spitfire Pumpkin on his adventures, she ran away from home for a night where she spent years in Spitfire Pumpkin’s world.

name: Conrad Millow
description:
Title: Son of Tonik

A mysterious kid that discovers Spitfire Pumpkin’s presence. Although much to the dismay of Julius, he attracts the attention of Maggie and is supportive of her running away. He knows martial arts and carries the sigil of Tonik.

name: Aurelia
description:
Title: Princess

A beautiful princess, Aurelia was named after the world of which many believed her to be from. She was the most sought out woman in the world and thought of herself as just an ordinary girl. During a war of her country and Atlantis, Aurelia escaped to the mountains with several of her subjects never to be seen or heard from again. Her whereabouts remains unknown with many believing she became a Egyptian Queen and other believing her to become the last royal figure of Atlantis after marrying its last king.

name: Zelina
description: Young girl that was saved by Zane, she is the primary reason behind Zane becoming a hero and embracing his angelic nature.

name: Avita
description: During his moments as a soldier amongst the demonic army of hell, Zane saved Avita and from this moment she inspired him to become a soldier of good and save those that otherwise can’t protect themselves. She is the major focul point in Zane’s backstory.

name: Edmund Jackson
description:
Title: Journalist

A human that sees Blaze first attempt at using his speed and gives him the name Blaze. He is a journalist and writes about the Blaze and his superhero efforts.

name: Jackson Owens
description:
Title: Father of Samuel Owens

Father of Samuel Owens, he is captured and later killed by the Army of Chaos

name: Cash “William” Johnson
description:
Title: Salesman

Is a salesman that appears throughout the comics as a comic relief in most dangerous plots. He would sell anything at any time for a buck and would appear almost immediately if he feels something is valuable. Because of his rude nature at times, most of his attempts are thwarted by a major character at the point of him trying to sell something.

name: Juliana Williamson
description: Student at the University of London in the early 1900s, she died in late 1952 due to lung cancer. She was friends with Kylie Lazaron when the two went to college together.

name: Landry Bost
description: Assistant to Cash “William” Johnson and loyal friend, although he doesn’t agree with any of Cash’s motives, he does stick with him even when they are abducted by aliens and threaten. He is usually the solid thinker when Cash Johnson isn’t thinking straight. Along with Cash, he appears when something isn’t right and often acts as a comedic relief.

name: Lazarus
description:
Title: scholar

Ancient scholar that wrote the stories of the fallen Elitshian Empire, he wrote about its beautiful lands and from his writings, he inspired many future scholars to go on a search of the once standing city. He existed sometime between 45 b.c to 100 b.c

name: Lucius
description:
Title: General in the Elitshian Army

One of the many generals in the Elitshian Army, he is probably the most known next to Magnus because of his unusual fighting techniques. Although badly criticized by his fellow soldiers. He won every battle he entered; he would later die of syphilis from a prostitute given to him by an enemy of his.

name: Magnus
description:
Title: General in the Elitshian Army

One of the many generals of the Elitshian Army, he was probably best known for leading the Elitshian Army into a successful battle against the Roman Empire. He would die of scabies and his son; Marcellus would carry his honor as new general of the Elitshian Army.

name: Marcellus
description:
Title: Leader of the Elitshian Army

Son to Magnus & Abelia, he took over his father’s army after his death. He was known to be a brute and easily angered leader. He killed many of his subjects to better position himself as a force dared to go up against. From his reign he would later die of old age and lived for 80 years as a leader and often enemy of the Elitshian Army.

name: Augustus Devale
description: Scientist and brother to Connor Devale (also known as Vipor)

name: Theodore Austin
description: All-star baseball player in the 1990s before his mysterious disappearance which shook a nation. He returned later unaged and continued to play baseball with a new team nearly 20 years later. He went to win two games, receive his own statue for his miraculous return. His disappearance is still mystery although his UFO obsessed parents believe that it was due to aliens, partially because he doesn't remember what happened to him in the last 20 years and how he hasn't aged a day.

name: Viviana Owens
description:
Title: Mother of Samuel Owens

Mother of Samuel Owens, captured by the Army of Chaos

name: Atticus Strong
description:
Title: Inventor

A scientist and father to Kia Strong (also known as Soundcage), his company has since created several experiments that has turned out evil, he left the company after finding out exactly what they were up to. The company is the same company that caused several mutated experiments that often fights the team Waveform.

name: Andreas Bowen
description: Hispanic man that often speaks his language when hes in danger, he is a comic relief that has little courage when faced with a fight. He appears at various times throughout many character battles and missions, almost at instant random moments.

name: Aeliana D’strange
description: She was born into slavery and appeared to Dustin in one of his visions as someone that passed away almost two hundred years ago.

name: Ace Richardson
description:
Title: Kylie Lazaron’s love interest

The boy that Kylie saved when she was in her final year of school. She fell in love with him and they briefly dated into their first year of college until he found out who she was and started spreading rumors about her around campus.

name: Abelia Cast
description:
Title: ex-wife to Magnus & mother of Marcellus

Ex-wife to Magnus and mother to Marcellus, she appeared as a faithful wife with no wrongdoings, however her appearance is how she managed to stay with wealth. She was called the Whore of Lostazia. From her she gave birth to several children, all of which were later murdered because of them being born out of wedlock. She contracted several diseases in her time and even gave scabies to her husband. She was murdered by him after he found out of her betrayal, he died days later.

name: Antonius Mugana
description:
Title: Legacy Fighter Mechanic

One of the Legacy Fighters that uses his mechanic skills to build very powerful vehicles and weaponry for his team.

name: Apollos Riverdan
description:
Title: Legacy Fighter & Destroyers opposer

A rebellious fighter who opposes both the Legacy Fighters & Legacy Destroyers, he has advance technology that he uses to fight his opponents.

name: Axel Bucanen
description:
Title: Freedom Rider

Freedom Rider and father to Valentina Bucanen, as member and leader of the Freedom Rider, Axel uses old world weapons fight his enemies.

name: Caius Reings
description:
Title: Legacy Fighter

One of the Legacy Fighters, he uses his technology enhanced speed to defeat his opponents.

name: Isabella Richardson
description:
Title: Freedom Fighter

Scientist and member of the Freedom Fighters current generation. She is the rational thinker of the group and the calm one in the face of danger.

name: Jack Spindle
description:
Title: Leader of the Legacy Fighters

Leader of the Legacy Fighters and main antagonists to the Freedom Fighters. He is the love interest to Valentia, his fellow team member.

name: Jesse Peterson
description:
Title: Ally of the Legacy Fighters

Handsome man with military experience, he uses his rash thinking to fight any enemy, along with Jack and Caius he leads the group of Legacy Fighters on missions.

name: Marius Rempul
description:
Title: Legacy Destroyer

One of the many Legacy Destroyers, he is also the youngest of the team.

name: Maximus Am
description:
Title: Legacy Fighter

One of the Legacy Fighters and often compared enemy to Quintus Olmgrude.

name: Primus Rage
description: Main antagonists to the Legacy Fighters, he rules the Eastern and Southern parts of Legacy City with an iron fist. He is commander of the Legacy Destroyers.

name: Quintia
description:
Title: Legacy Destroyer

Skilled arsonist that loves fire and burning stuff down. She is ally of Quintus.

name: Quintus Olmgrude
description:
Title: Legacy Destroyer

One of the strongest Legacy Destroyers, he is a big guy with technology advanced muscles and strength.

name: Tatiana
description:
Title: former Freedom Fighter

Originally one of the Freedom Riders until she had a daughter.

name: Valentina Bucanen
description:
Title: Legacy Fighter

Daughter of the Freedom Rider, she is a member of the Legacy Fighters. She betrayed her people and her father because she fell in love with Jack Spindle.

name: Tony Eriksson
description:
Title: Main Character

Tony is one of the few million humans that can see the supernatural world. When his fiancé’ and him moved to a new neighborhood to escape from the big city. He starts to experience strange things, yet no one believes him.

name: Nick Briggs - Eriksson
description:
Title: Main Character

Nick is a kind, honest, and avid surfer that loves Tony since they first met. The two moves to a small suburban town to escape the busy life of the big city. He is unaware of the supernatural forces within this new place.

name: Jolie Michaelson
description:
Title: Main Character

One of the neighbors of Tony and Nick. She is nosey and one of the few residents that can see and hear the supernatural forces in the neighborhood. She becomes Tony close friend and often fellow spy on the neighbors.

name: Natalie Jones
description:
Title: Resident of Brettwood

Former military brat and chief officer, Natalie moved to Brettwood with her wife to better handle her PTSD. She is smart, loud, and one of the few residents of Brettwood that can hear (although she can’t see) the supernatural world.

name: Jessica Kims
description:
Title: Resident of Brettwood

Wife to Natalie and unaware of what is happening in Brettwood. She is a fitness trainer and avid foodie.

name: Anthony Brimwood
description:
Title: Resident of Brettwood & ghost

A ghost that appears as a resident of Brettwood, he is unaware that he is dead, although only a few residents including Tony can see and hear him. He is married to James who can’t see him but can still smell his cologne.

name: James O’Donnell
description:
Title: Resident of Brettwood

James is a lawyer and cousin of Julia Capulet from Roman & Julia story. He lost his husband Anthony is a skiing accident and although he can smell Anthony’s cologne, he is unaware that Anthony is still around him. James can smell the dead in the original scents, something he doesn’t discover until Anthony moves on in the Chapter 4 series finale.

name: Casius “Cas” Vincent
description:
Title: Resident of Brettwood

Former model and sexist that lives in Brettwood, he is often seen as a comic relief and is admire because of his looks by his neighbors. He is unaware of the supernatural activity in the neighborhood.

name: Mach Townsend
description:
Title: Resident of Brettwood

Mack moved to Brettwood in hopes to unlock its mysterious supernatural activity. He is a self-declared ghost hunter. Although, he can’t interact with the supernatural world directly, he built equipment that allows him to see and hear them. That is when the equipment works which is rarely.

name: Roman Montague
description:
Title: Main Character

A smart, dashing, and previously wealthy young man who like his family are new to the world of poverty. He dreams and works to become a successful surgeon like his father. He falls in love with Julia almost instantly when his family is forced to downsize and move into a duplex.

name: Julia Capulet
description:
Title: Main Character

Beautiful, strong willed, and destined to be someone great. Julia dreams of becoming a successful lawyer one day. She instantly fell in love with Roman when his family moved into her duplex.

name: Paul Capulet
description:
Title: Father of Julia

Matriarch of the Capulet family and primary bread winner. When he died, it left the family in debt after it was discovered that he owed a lot of money to various gangs, corporations, and schemes he hatched to get the family through hard times. Natasha met him one night while working at a diner and the two fell instantly in love.

name: Natasha “Nat” Capulet
description:
Title: Mother of Julia

A levelheaded and honest woman that would do anything for her family. When her husband Paul died, she was left with her children and had to work odd jobs to make money. She is furious over Roman killing Michael and during Chapter 4 attempts to have Julia’s old boyfriend Paris to fight him. This is quickly resolved after Roman saves Julia from being robbed at gunpoint.

name: Michael Tybalt York
description:
Title: Julia’s cousin

Cousin to Julia Capulet and rival to Roman for most of Chapter 3. He is killed by mistake by Roman when Michael kills Roman’s friend Marcus “Mercutio”.

name: Patricia Hyewood
description:
Title: Nurse

Patricia is Natasha Capulet close friend and the one that she comes to during her divorce from Paul Capulet. She is kind, loving, and helps the family with medical things when they are unable to afford it. In Chapter 3 of Roman & Julia, she leaves for Seattle to become a resident nurse.

name: Peter Holder
description:
Title: Patricia Hyewood’s assistant

Peter is Patricia’s loyal, yet shy assistant that helps around the clinic. He is secretly in love with her, although she sees him as a little brother. He leaves in Chapter 3 when he confesses his love for Patricia, of which she doesn’t return the affection and moves to Seattle.

name: Gregory Lovell
description:
Title: Michael Capulet’s bestfriend

Friend to Michael and Sampson. Gregory suffers from bi-polar although he keeps it from his friends. He leaves in Chapter 2 after it becomes to much for him, and he leaves to get help.

name: Sampson Warwick
description:
Title: Michael Capulet’s bestfriend

Quick to get into a fight, Sampson is relatively strong and is an avid gamer. He was once the school bully when he was younger but has grown into an honest young man. He has a crush on Julia Capulet. He moves away for school in Chapter 2.

name: Antonio Montague
description:
Title: Father of Roman

Similar in stature and appearance as his son Roman, Antonio was a successful surgeon and was rich. His family lived in a large mansion on the cost of NYC. He was presumed dead which left the family in shambles. Being left out of the will, it was discovered in Chapter 3, that he is alive and gay and lives a luxurious life with his boyfriend in Spain.

name: Benvolio “Ben” Robinson
description:
Title: Cousin of Roman

Loyal friend and cousin of Roman, while Roman is usually depicted as a naïve person, Ben is smart and cautious. He lives with his family in an estate that is often seen as a gateway for an often youthful Roman in their teens.

name: Balthasar Skinner
description:
Title: Roman’s friend

Balthasar is a close friend to Roman and once his childhood caretaker. He is Roman’s age and is usually the one that bailed him out of trouble. He visits through Chapter 4 as Roman’s friend and close confidant.

name: Abram Jefferson
description:
Title: background character

Abram appears in Chapter 2 in a fight with Gregory and Sampson. He is often a background character throughout Chapter 1 & Chapter 2 of Roman & Julia story.

name: Anthony Capulet
description:
Title: younger brother to Julia

Anthony is younger brother to Julia and is very close to his mother Natasha. He is sent to camp at the end of Chapter 1 and appears briefly throughout Chapter 2.

name: Benjamin “Potpan” Capulet
description:
Title: older brother of Julia

Benjamin is older brother to Julia and is distant from his family after he moves out prior to the story. He makes frequent appearances throughout Chapter 1, 2, and 3. He appears again in Chapter 5 for the marriage of Roman & Julia. He gets the nickname Potpan because he used to wet the bed which only Julia and Natasha know why he has that name.

name: Frank Capulet
