description:
Title: Paul Capulet’s father

Paul’s father and Natasha’s father-in-law that appears throughout Chapter 1 until he dies in the final episode of the story. He is kind, always has fatherly advice, and admires his grandchildren and daughter in law Natasha.

name: Esmeralda Montague
description:
Title: Mother of Roman

Esmeralda is a beautiful stay at home mother and former model. She lost everything when her husband left the family through faking his death. She moves the family to a home which she thought was all theirs until she discovers that it’s shared with another family. She is mostly ignorant to poverty life and often must be reminded that she isn’t rich anymore. Throughout Chapter 1, 2, & 3 she tries to become rich again through various schemes and reviving her modeling career.

name: Friar Lawrence
description:
Title: Mentor of Roman

Friar is close friend to Esmeralda and mentor to her children when they were young. He moves to Ireland shortly after Chapter 1 ends. He isn’t seen again until Chapter 5 for Roman & Julia’s wedding.

name: John Lawrence
description:
Title: Friar’s brother

John is Friar’s brother that died in episode 5 during a backstory that saw Friar Lawrence first meeting with the Montague family. He was a proud man that cared deeply for others.

name: Jimmy Madison
description:
Title: Apothecary throughout season 4 & 5

Jimmy Madison is an apothecary that poisoned Roman during Season 5, causing Roman to be hospitalized. He was arrested and later died in prison, while Roman recovered.

name: Watchmen
description:
Title: Secret Military unit

Watchmen a secret organization that appears in Chapter 5 and sets up the Roman & Julia spinoff Verona. They are usually seen as an intelligence agency with dark secrets. Julia searches for answers about them which leads to her death in the series finale of Chapter 5.

name: Rosaline Tedesco
description:
Title: Roman’s old love interest & lead of Verona spinoff, detective, and spy

Rosaline was once the love interest to Roman before he moved and met Julia. She is first seen as impatient and then later returns in Chapter 5 as the lead character in the spinoff Verona. She is now a detective and spy with fighting skills and leads a double life. Her primary objective is to study the cases surrounding the Watchmen.

name: Derrick Petruchio
description:
Title: Rosaline’s friend and trainer

Derrick Petruchio is an Italian dancer and friend of Rosaline that often assists on her fight against the Watchmen. He is a skilled fighter and former wrestler.

name: Valentine Rose
description:
Title: Leader of the Watchmen

Valentine is the leader of the Watchmen and love interest of Rosaline. At first, he starts a job at Rosaline’s precinct to watch her and learn everything she knows about his organization. Later he develops feelings for her until she finds out who really is.

name: Marcus Mercutio McEnery
description:
Title: Technical Engineer and friend to Rosaline

He appears in Chapter 1 of Roman & Julia as friend to Roman but appears in the spinoff Verona as friend to Rosaline and her close confidant. He is a technical engineer and speaks numerous languages.

name: Paris Franks
description:
Title: Member of Watchmen & former love interest of Julia

Old friend of Julia and her previous love interest before Roman. He left in Chapter 1 after she confessed her love to Roman. He returned in the spinoff Verona as a member of the Watchmen.

name: Robert Curtis Stephens
description:
Title: Mayor of Verona

Robert is the mayor of Verona and is aware of the Watchmen and wants them out. He works secretly with Rosaline and her unit to provide them financial support.

name: Samuel Page
description:
Title: Member of Watchmen

Samuel Page is friend and fellow member of Watchmen with Paris Franks. He is stubborn and slow to act to issues, but nonetheless very loyal to his friends and has a strong work ethic.

name: Marcus Davis
description: Once ex-convict that helped save several people from the attack of the undead during the Dead Rises Saga. From this he became one of the stronger allies in the fight against the undead, although he had no abilities, he manages to survive the fight although almost all of his fellow team members were killed while trying to find a place without the undead rising.

name: Betty Boop
description:
Title: Main Character

Betty dreams of her chance at stardom on the stage. Through shenanigans, Betty often gets into situations just to become a broadway actress and singer. One day she meets a man that promises her a life of stardom and she takes it. Betty is a flapper girl with a big heart and because of her innocence of mind, she is often taken advantage of and dismisses serious situations.

name: Fitz Bimbo Murray
description:
Title: Betty Boop’s friend and assistant

Fitz Bimbo Murray “Bimbo” is Betty’s love interest and fiercely protective of her and her passions. He isn’t the brightest but has a lot of heart. He dances very well and usually joins Betty both on stage and during her adventures looking for stardom.

name: Gus “KoKo” Fleischer
description:
Title: Clown

Friend of Betty, Gus “KoKo” Fleischer was a proud clown that would join Betty on her adventures into becoming a starlight. He was a comedic person that loved to create parties for kids and those who attends Betty’s shows.

name: William “Popeye” Jack
description:
Title: Sailor& Main Character

William “Popeye” Jack was a sailor that travelled the seven seas in search of adventure. He was always attempting to prove himself as the strongest person. His enemy and in some stories friend, Bluto would often run into him on their many adventures. His love interest is Olive Oyl.

name: Olive Oyl
description:
Title: Popeye’s love interest

Love interest of Popeye, Olive is a stern and levelheaded woman that loves with all her heart. She fell in love with Popeye because although he is brute and looks constantly for fights with others to determine his strength. He has a heart of gold.

name: Bluto
description:
Title: Popeye’s archenemy

Bluto is a stereotypical pirate that roams the seven seas in search of adventure and treasure. He often butts heads with Popeye and attempts to attract Olive. He is exceptionally strong and he believes he is the descendant to Black Beard the pirate.

name: Edward Teach “Blackbeard”
description:
Title: Popeye’s enemy

Blackbeard “Edward Teach” was a famous pirate that sailed and conquered the seven seas. His legend was grand, and he often fought with other pirates including his own crew. He discovered the Lost Mountain where it was believed to be the doorway to the Black Forest.

name: Peter Pan
description:
Title: Half Fairy, Half Human

A smart and adventurous boy that discovers fairy dust. He travels between the Lost Mountain, Black Forest, and other parts of the human world to find others that he feels is lost like himself. He is unaware of his fairy ancestry although he can fly and use fairy magic quite easily. He makes his appearance in Fairies and is mentioned briefly in the Lazarons story by Kain Lazaron.

name: Lost Boys
description:
Title: Residents of Lost Mountain

Lost Boys are a crew of a hundred strong lost children that Peter took to the Lost Mountain to become their home. On the island the crew are strong, immortal, and wants for nothing but fighting and singing. They vary greatly and are usually seen taking Peter’s orders as they look to him as their leader.

name: Abbadon
description: Also considered a Belki to the Elitshians because of his later betrayal to Seraphina.

name: Abymael
description: One of the eldest of angels, he help create thunderbolts and provided a large scale of them to GOD to experiment with creating weather.

name: Adriel
description: Angel of the Sea. He is the Father over the first ocean that is located at the western edge of Heaven. From it flows all the waters of every known aquatic place in existence.

name: Ahriman
description:
Note: Zoroastrianism

The two headed angel that can blow ice and fire from its heads. It is a gentle being that only arouses when it is confronted from a direction it can’t see.

name: Ambriel
description: A beautiful angel with long golden hair that makes the stardust of the stars. She is short and slender and has over a million children. Everyone becoming the stars of the sky. Her youngest children are the most popular the zodiacs of the western world.

name: Amesha Spenta
description:
Note: Zoroastrianism

A dark skinned angel that uses her rough hair to blow wind across the skies of Heaven. She is smart thinking and quick witted. She laughs and plays the harp amongst GOD’s choir.

name: Angelica
description: The Angel of Trust. She is loud and speaks only the truth. She once sat at the foot of GOD speaking only the truth to the young creation. She now watches over his words and speaks to others using his words.

name: Angelina
description: Angelica’s sister. She is prideful and possesses the Sword of Heaven which unlocks strong powers that she used to help the Arch Angels defend Heaven against Santaniel. She has warrior armor made of pure light and flashes across the night sky carrying the world’s light.

name: Anura
description: Mother to Miada and inspiration behind the school of the same name, her picture is shown on nearly every hall throughout Anura

name: Arariel
description:
Note: Jewish mythology

He created the temples on Earth that honors the angels of Heaven. His creations were later remodeled in the same honor.

name: Archangels
description: Powerful angels that are suited to fight and kill demons. They are responsible for defeating Santaniel.

name: Ariel
description: The fish like angel that rides a chariot made of scales and harden shells. She is blissful and speaks in hymms. Her hair is the water of which the angels drink.

name: Azazel
description: Spy, that played the role of a demon in hopes to find out what Santaniel was doing once his was banished to Hell.

name: Azrael
description: Angel of Death. His primordial existence is hinted that he may have existed before the Ultimate One and before Anka (the primordial Chaos that birthed the Ultimate One). He descends from the Previous World.

name: Barachiel
description: Blacksmith of Heaven. He created the Arch Angels weapons and their armor and forged many great weapons including the Throne of GOD.

name: Bene Elohim
description: A grave watcher. He is an angel that was sent to Earth to watch over cemeteries making sure that the dead wasn’t disturbed.

name: Cael
description: The ancient angel that took out his own heart to give to GOD as an offering for disobeying his orders to remain in Heaven before Santaniel’s attack. GOD forgave him resulting in his heart being placed back in its place, however he was never seen after this.

name: Camael Chamuel
description: The dog like being that protects the Gates of Prayers found in Lower Heaven. It’s a massive beasts with wings and 10 legs.

name: Cassiel
description: A angel with direct contact with humans.

name: Cherub
description: A powerful angel that protected the Throne of GOD from Santaniel. They can become one to become the Cherubim. Separately, they follow Jessana early on allowing others to follow in love using their magical arrows.

name: Dara
description: An angel of Heaven, she has white hair and small white wings

name: Darda'I
description: An angel of Heaven with brown hair and white eyes

name: Dina
description: Wife of Yonrohs, she left him during his youth so that he could create the gods and in return could create the world and everything in it upon GODs decree. She watched over him from a distance and along with his mother, Seraphina, welcomed him to Heaven upon his death.

name: Dominions
description: Mischief angels that guarded Heaven during the attack of the fallen angels. They are many and have appeared throughout many stories as powerful angels that will fight with a fiery roar and triumphed in all of their battles. They are a legion of almost 2,206 angels all chained togethered.

name: Dumah
description: An angel that has direct contact with humans.

name: Eremiel
description: An angel that takes care of the supernatural creatures of Heaven.

name: Evangeline
description: The beautiful angel that makes constant contact with the supernatural world.

name: Gabriel
description: An Arch angel that takes the form of a man and woman that has blue hair and blue armor. He is a distant warrior that will fight to the death and charges into battle with his massive Hammer of Justice.

name: Gabriel
description: The female form of Gabriel. She has long purple hair and purple armor. Sometimes they appear together however, for the most part they appear away from each other. They were told by higher angels to keep their distance because of their intense connection that can upset the balance of justice.

name: Gadreel
description: The unhappy angel that was placed to guard the Garden of Eden. When Santaniel sneaked into the garden, he was punished and banished from Heaven in return.

name: Gagiel
description:
Note: Angel of Fishermen

The boatsmith that roams the Sea of Life that exists between all things. He lives somewhere in the Ocean of Life.

name: Grigori
description: The ever watching beings that sit at the edge of Heaven watching over all things. They are seen with many eyes, vast array of powers, and large heads.

name: Hadraniel
description: The Angel of Love. She possesses near omnipresence in which she uses to send love across all domains. Her powers are later transcended to Jessana upon her birth.

name: Hamalat al-Arsh
description: A centaur like angel that shoots glowing bows and arrows to give stars their glowing nature.

name: Haniel
description: Responsible for creating the Fountain of Holy Water.

name: Harut
description: Responsible for building many structures found in Heaven.

name: Hesediel
description: The angel responsible for building many of the structures found in Heaven.

name: Israfel
description:
Note: also written Israfil

An elder angel that assisted in created the scrolls on which the words of GOD are written.

name: Javan
description: An angel that assisted in brewing Holy Water for the Fountain of Holy Water.

name: Jegudiel
description: One of the angels of Death that mostly appears in the Southern part of the world.

name: Jehoel
description: A guardian angel that guards and guides mostly artists and musicians.

name: Jequn
description: A guardian angel that guides and guards mostly children. He helps them create other guides in the forms of Imaginary Friends.

name: Jerahmeel
description: A guardian angel that mostly visits the middle east.

name: John
description: A follower of Jesus Christ that was turned to an angel upon his arrival in Heaven. He sometimes visits Earth to maintain the legends of his previous history on Earth.

name: Jophiel
description: A elder angel that watches over the Fountain of Holy Water.

name: Kasdeja
description: A guardian angel

name: Kemuel
description: A guardian angel

name: Kiraman Katibin
description: A guardian angel, he has three forms, all of which are men of different races, different attitudes, and different age groups.

name: Kosmiel
description: He attends the home of the Cherubs. Often can be seen laughing with them in paintings.

name: Kushiel
description: The gardener of Heaven’s most beautiful landscapes.

name: Laila
description: A beautiful angel that was slain in battle protecting Michael in the war against the fallen angels.

name: Leliel
description: A soldier in Heaven’s army.

name: Lucifer
description: Unlike legends speak, he was not of Santaniel later story. However, Lucifer was the beautiful and eldest of all angels. His name meant the bringer of light of which he was associated with as to bring forth the sun across Heaven. He resided next to GOD standing tall next to him at the Throne of Glory in Araboth.

name: Maalik
description: A soldier in Heaven’s army, he was killed in the war against the fallen angels.

name: Malik
description: A strong armed angel and soldier

name: Marut
description: Guardian of the Tree of Life found in the Garden of Eden.

name: Metatron
description: The writer and translator of GODs words.

name: Michael
description: Original holder of the Key of Humanity and Arch Angel. He governs Maon and is one of GODs first angels.

name: Mikhail
description: A nature angel, she helped plant the trees and flowers found in the Garden of Eden.

name: Moroni
description: A nature angel that planted the first tree in the Garden of Eden and later provided the apples that was forbidden to eat as a test by GOD to Adam and Eve.

name: Mu’aqqibat
description: A vampiric angel that resides in the night. It appears to keep demons at bay from those that worship GOD.

name: Munkar
description: A spirit angel that resides in Eternity.

name: Muriel
description: A water angel

name: Nakir
description: A warrior angel

name: Nuriel

name: Orifiel
description: A water angel

name: Pahaliah
description: A angel that watches over the spirit world.

name: Penemue
description: A smoke like angel that speaks in fluent Russian

name: Peter

description: The horsemen

name: Gibborim

name: Tseba’im

name: Gedudim
description: The troops, the raiders

name: Memunim
description: The appointed ones, the deputies

name: Mesharethim

name: Malakhim

name: Degalim
description: The divisions

name: Sabalim
description: The bearers of burdens

name: Principalities
description: Angels that help spread the laws of Heaven across the different levels.

name: Puriel
description: The angel of purity, she guides the pure of heart to their respective domains in Heaven.

name: Qaphsiel
description: An angel consisting of good and positive energy. He is rarely seen outside of his domain near the Temple.

name: Rabia
description: A short angel that can speak and provides the voices to all creatures of existence.

name: Rafaela
description: A saint and the whisperer to many legendary women in human history.

name: Raguel
description: An Arabic styled angel that resides over the Altar in Maon in Heaven.

name: Raphael
description: An angel of heaven, he has the same name of the Arch Angel. However, his importance is only known because of text that speaks of two Raphael named angels.

name: Raphael
description: An Arch Angel and commander over Raqia with Zachariel. He takes the North and West while Zachariel takes the South and East. Both command the center where the prison of Fallen angels reside.

name: Raqib
description: A middle eastern angel that speaks in almost every language ever existed.

name: Raziel
description: A sharp tongued angel that is a soldier amongst Ridwan’s army.

name: Remiel
description: One of the soldiers of Ridwan’s army.

name: Ridwan
description: A chief that led a small army to Hell to research its layout and spy on Santaniel.

name: Sachiel
description: One of the angels that sings the gospels of Heaven.

name: Samael
description: The ruler over Makon. He provided the voices to the Song-Uttering Choirs of Heaven.

name: Sandalphon
description: A greedy angel that eats at darkness. He commands a chariot of stars to drive across the sky eating the darkness.

name: Sariel
description: A goat that provides milk to newborn souls to nurse them into existence.

name: Selaphiel
description: One of the angels that sings the gospels of Heaven.

name: Seraph
description: Beautiful angels that are the highest forms of angels. They are direct authority figures that issues out commands to all of Heaven. When their horns are used, a war is imminent.

name: Seraphiel
description: Father to Zon, the Prisoner. He fell in love with a demon that help send their son to Earth to evade the war in Heaven. Zon was later reformed to become a great hero that lived for nearly 3,000 years.

name: Seraphina
description: The beautiful angel that is also mother to Yonrohs, the father of the Gods.

name: Shaitaan
description: The monk that while on Earth became so devoted to his cause, was made an angel instantly on his death.

name: Shamsiel
description: The angel that helps writes down GODs words onto the Heavenly Parchments.

name: Simiel
description: The angel that created the first disease at the order of GOD to help wash away evil on Earth.

name: Temeluchus
description: A spider like angel that provides cures to many diseases on Earth.

name: Tennin
description: Angel of sports in Heaven. The word Tennis comes from his name.

name: Thrones
description: Powerful legion of angels that protects Arabol. They are giant angels that possesses heavenly embowed instruments. Their golden armor, heavenly light, and deep thundering voices are said to haunt many of their enemies.

name: Tzaphqiel
description: An angel that guards the prison for fallen angels in Raqia. He is the father to the Celestial Guardian of Raqia.

name: Uriel
description: A blinded angel that speaks in the first language forgotten by humans. She is a skilled warrior and was slain in battle against Santaniel.

name: Uriel
description: She helps GOD create Eve while her husband Yael helped create Adam.

name: Uzziel
description: A warrior angel that was killed in the battle against Santaniel.

name: Virtues
description: Powerful angels that provides authority across the lower levels of Heaven. They are the parents to the High Council and from them comes some orders for the High Council.

name: Wormwood
description: A worm like angel that can take over the body of another being and through them, it can provide god like powers and the knowledge of Heaven.

name: Yael
description: He helped GOD create Adam while his wife help creates Eve.

name: Yehudiel
description: A gifted angel that taught how to speak to humans on creation day.

name: Yerachmiel
description: A serpent like angel that speaks in the first language developed on Earth by humans.

name: Zabaniyah
description: Guardian angel

name: Zachariel
description: Ruler over the level Raqia. He helped create the prison for fallen angels.

name: Zadkiel
description: A forbidden angel that was punished for leaking the location of the Garden of Eden to Santaniel.

name: Zephon
description: One of the guardians to the prison of fallen angels in Raqia.

name: Zophiel
description: One of the youngest angels. He was sent to Earth to watch them and learn from them, in hopes to make a better angel by learning from GODs favorite creations.

name: Koniel
description: A dutiful angel that once sat at the right side of GOD’s throne sending his visions down to a select individual. He was considered the King of Oracles and could see into the vast multiverse. Aside from GOD, Koniel had complete omnipotence, omni awareness, and could is even aware of the greater Eden.

name: Boshriel
description: A powerful angel whose wings are often seen appearing as a flowing dress that could wrap the world twice. Her appearance is very elegant and almost godlike. One of the first original angels created by GOD, Boshriel was the first being next to GOD to experience visions of the future. She was a favorite to The Neither and is referred to as the Queen of Oracles. Boshriel is the ancestor to Koniel and is considered to be a myth.

name: Aamon
description: Creator of Hell, he designed it and built it starting with just one mountain.

name: Abaddon
description: Leader to the Knights of Hell. She is all powerful and all knowing. She consorted with Belckus before his slumber and thus took over his post as command to the Knights of Hell. Some say that she is as strong if not stronger than his son, Santaniel.

name: Abalam
description: Demon soldier to Abaddon.

name: Abezethibou
description:
Note: Testament of Solomon

Soldier demon of mid-level status.

name: Abraxas
description:
Note: Gnosticism

A soldier demon of mid-level status.

description: A lower level demon with four faces

name: Ad-Dajjal
description: A high level demon that stands at the door to Santaniel’s tomb waiting for the final war.

name: Adramelech
description: A war demon that has led numerous wars against the humans of Earth.

name: Aeshma
description: A magical demon that is summoned by many magical beings as a way of fighting others including other demons. Its home is hidden far away from all other demons because of this.

name: Agaliarept
description: A demon that built the first temple in honor of Santaniel while he was on Earth.

name: Agares
description: An old demon that help build Hell out of Belckus’ body.

name: Agiel
description: A mermaid demon that is enemy to the Mermadic Kingdom.

name: Ahriman
description: A mid-level demon with numerous statues dedicated in his honor.

name: Aim
description: Mid-level demon that rose in the ranks from a lower level demon status by killing numerous world leaders.

name: Aka Manah
description: A horse demon of lower level status.

name: Ala
description: A short demon that eats the testicles of newborn sons. Later, it spits out the testicles which hatches into demons.

name: Alal
description: A mid-level demon

name: Alastor
description: A mid-level demon

name: Alloces
description: A mid-level demon

name: Allu
description: A mid-level demon

name: Amaymon
description: A mid-level demon

name: Amdusias
description: A lower level demon with heightened intelligence. He often appears on Earth as a businessman.

name: Ammut
description: A demon god similar to Amon. He performs worships and answers prayers if someone commits an act of murder in his honor.

name: Amon
description: A demon god that is worshipped on Earth. He appears briefly as a deity that grants the prayers of anyone that leaves a human sacrifice at his altar.

name: Amy
description: A powerful demon and one of the Knights of Hell. She consorted with Lilith before giving birth to a baby known as the Antichrist. She appears almost all human until direct sunlight casts her true appearance. To resolve this she covers her skin while in public.

name: Anamalech
description: A large demon warrior

name: Andhaka
description: A house demon of nightmares.

name: Andras
description: A demon of enhanced speed that races across Hell causing headaches to the tortured souls.

name: Andrealphus
description: A demonic warrior

name: Andromalius
description: A demonic warrior

name: Antichrist
description: The eldest of the Seven Princes’ of Hell. He has existed in stories as long as Jesus Christ as he serves a similar purpose for Santaniel as Jesus did to GOD. He has all power and knowledge and controls most of the factions of demons that are on Earth.

name: Anzu
description: A demonic soldier

name: Apep
description: A demonic soldier

name: Apollyon
description: A demon that modeled himself after the Greek god Apollo. He uses light to blind others and eat out their eyes.

name: Armaros
description: A demonic soldier

name: Asag
description: A demonic hag that assists evil magical beings on Earth.

name: Asb'el
description: A demon that was born from the liver of Adam while he was asleep. It was believed that he was created by Eve, during the time she was discovering her magical powers.

name: Asmodai
description: The leader of the demonic faction that stands at the Gates to Hell. He was once one of the Knights of Hell until they revoked his membership because of him wanting to take Belckus place as Go King over hell.

name: Astaroth
description: A powerful demon and Knight of Hell. He leads the army of powerful sorcerers on Earth to take over its many magical domains.

name: Astarte
description: One of the Knights of Hell. She lives in the stars and is the only fallen angels that remained in close contact with her previous allies.

name: Asura
description: A star demon under the direct servitude to Astarte.

name: Azazel
description: Like his angelic counterpart, Azazel was once known by another name however, during his fall he changed it to match that of the Angel of Death.

name: Azi Dahaka
description: A demonic warlock that can use spells of others just by being in close proximity of them.

name: Baal
description: One of the Knights of Hell. He is not as strong as the others however uses his arrows to open doorways to foreign places to unleash demons and demonic creatures.

name: Balam
description: An orange specter that moves across the Earth using a magic carpet. He grants wishes as long as one of them is to kill someone close to the wisher.

name: Balberith
description: A demon that writes in the Book of Souls which a direct counterpart of Book of Sanctuary used by evil witches.

name: Bali Raj
description: A demon that floats above the ground carrying the souls of those that died in its homeland.

name: Banshee
description: A terrifying demon that screams men to death. They are the lost souls of witches. Their screams are only heard when danger is near.

name: Baphomet
description: A demon poet that appeared during the Shakespeare age.

name: Barbas
description: Demon of dreams, he is also known as the demon of illusion.

name: Barbatos
description: A island demon that moves the Earth in response to the direction of the Sun and Moon.

name: Bathin
description: A demon warrior that uses the souls of angels.

name: Beelzebub
description: One of the Knights of Hell. In many stories he is so powerful that he is considered one of the avatars of Santaniel.

name: Behemoth
description: One of the Knights of Hell. One of the most powerful demons in Hell. It was one of the most powerful followers to Belckus.

name: Beherit
description: A phoenix that appears human when in front of those lesser than itself. It was turned evil when the promise of absolute power was offered by Belckus.

name: Beleth
description: A demon soldier, killed by a young Zane.

name: Belial
description: One of the Seven Princes’ of Hell. His long hair uses the scent of an angel to lure angels to him and then he kills them. Since he fell to Hell, he has killed over 200 angels.

name: Belphegor
description: Demon that killed Michael (original holder of the Key of Humanity, later killed by the Zane)

name: Berith
description: A demon of ancient origin. It appears throughout many stories and uses spells to control others.

name: Bhūta
description: A demon that writes down the orders and words of Belckus. He is the twin to Metatron and served as his close ally until he followed Belckus into Hell.

name: Bies
description: A lower demon with a hundred eyes.

name: Bifrons
description: A mid-level demon that commands many of the lower demons.

name: Boruta
description: A general that commands the mid-level demons.

name: Botis
description: A pirate demon and pirate under Davy Jones.

name: Buer
description: A lower demon with a large lower body.

name: Bukavac
description: A demon that can possess ghost.

name: Bune
description: A lower demon, he fell in love with a woman and the two had children that were killed because of their dual nature.

name: Bushyasta
description: A higher level demon and part of the Overlords. He was worshipped in numerous places as a powerful priest before his mentioned of being a demon.

name: Caacrinolaas
description: A demonic soul that was once of a human turned into a demon.

name: Caim
description: A lower demon

name: Crocell
description: A sea demon

name: Crone

name: Culsu
description: A plant demon

name: Daeva
description: A black faced demon with a white gold body

name: Dagon

name: Danjal

name: Dantalion
description: A demon that uses smoke to choke others

name: Dasa
description: A demon with long hair that can choke someone

name: Davy Jones
description: A spirit of a pirate that steals treasures, precious jewels, and uses a ghost ship to travel across different lands rather by land, sea, or air.

name: Decarabia
description: A giant rock demon that sits at the edge of bridges scaring travelers.

name: Demogorgon
description: A powerful gorgon that possesses a magical amulet that allows it to live for eternity.

name: Devil
description: Often mistaken to be Lucifer the angel, Santaniel the King of Hell, Belckus the God King of Evil, Samael the angel, and Sat the demon. He appears with a long pointy tail, sharp ears, giant hands, and he is one of the Seven Princes’ of Hell.

name: Div-e Sepid
description: A land demon that is called on to do various things including haunting new tenants.

name: Djinn
description: An evil genie that usually can be found in Hell. However, it can be summoned through magical objects mostly lamps that has something of it to trap it.

name: Donn
description: The demon god that rules over the lower southern part of Hell.

name: Drekavac
description: House demons that eat the meals prepared for the house. If there is no food then they will eat away at the toes of the resident.

name: Dzoavits
description: Evil animals that taunt humans and gives them nightmares.

name: Eligos
description: A black Pegasus that serves under powerful demons. It can travel to any dimension with free will.

name: Empusa
description: A Greek spirit that can act on someone’s darkest wishes by granting them.

name: Euryale
description: A Greek spirit that contains the power to trap someone in their fear.

name: Eurynome
description: A demon that lives deep within a valley hiding its body under rock and soil.

name: Eurynomos
description: The echo of the evil soul. It lives in the mountains and drowns the valleys with blood.

name: Familiars
description: Magical spirits taking the forms of animals watching over magical beings mostly witches and warlocks. Although, they are of demonic origin they are not evil and are very protective of those they are assigned to.

name: Focalor
description: A demonic preacher that preaches the words of Santaniel to devil worshippers.

name: Foras
description: A giant dog that barks cause earthquakes and tsunamis.

name: Forneus
description: A movable bear that is only seen in the light as it has a reflective body. It eats children.

name: Furcas
description: Demonic owls that serve as guides of students to the residents of Hizirinth.

name: Furfur
description: A giant furry demon that rolls around soaking up fear and despair.

name: Furies
description: Vengeful spirits of Greek legend. They represent retribution of humans and are called upon to seek revenge on the one that summoned them.

name: Gader'el
description: One of the fallen angels still holding onto its angelic powers.

name: Gaki
description: A demon fish that swims eating other fish and human swimmers.

name: Gello
description: A dolphin like demon that moves through the water at great speeds.

name: Glasya-Labolas
description: A glass like demon that can shatter glass by looking upon it.

name: Gorgon
description: A demon belonging to the family of Medusa. Like its Greek counterpart it can fly and turn things into various elements including stone, put something on fire.

name: Gremory
description: A mirror demon under the control of Mulloch.

name: Grigori
description: Mischievous demons that flies around the dying eating their souls.

name: Gualichu
description: A puppet demon that uses its yarn and wires to strangle someone to death. It uses toys and other puppets to spy on others

name: Gusion
description: A mirror demon under the control of Mulloch.

name: Haagenti
description: A gentle demon that speaks French. It hides under a bridge eating sweets and laughing with children.

name: Halphas
description: A hog like demon

name: Haures
description: Four headed demon goddess that predicts the past and future to demons.

name: Humbaba
description: A demon with a mouth the size of Hawaii. It has been asleep for nearly 4,000 years. It is said that its mouth serves as a gateway to Hell.

name: Iblis
description: An island size demon that carries the city of devil worshippers on its back.

name: Ifrit
description: A demonic entity that appears like giant fog

name: Incubus
description: A demon that feeds on the happiness of others and uses it as way to grow stronger and walk into the daylight.

name: Ipos
description: A demon with both male and female attributes.

name: Kabandha
description: Using its wings to fly above Hell to watch over the different levels.

name: Kali
description:

A demon priestess that performs rituals and marriages under the name of Belckus.

name: Kitsune
description: A spirit demon with a thousand tails. It looks like a giant grey fox with large fangs.

name: Kokb'ael
description: A trio of demons that speaks of Santaniel’s orders to the demonic army.

name: Kuntilanak
description: A big armored demon that has brute strength and force

name: Labal
description: A demon lamb that gave birth to the powers of demons in Santaniel’s army.

name: Lady Midday
description: A vampire like creature that calls on the power of her father Santaniel. She along with Lilith are the only two female children of Santaniel.

name: Lamashtu
description: A demon princess that has seduce, married, and had children with various kings on Earth.

name: Lamia
description: Stone creatures of demonic origin. They have existed for thousands of years creating properties in numerous mythologies.

name: Lechies
description: Slimy demons that eat at the souls of the tortured. On Earth they feed on the bodies of those that committed sins while in life.

name: Legion
description: A collection of high demons that serve under the Overlords. They are the strongest level of demons under the Knights of Hell and the Seven Princes’ of Hell.

name: Lempo
description: The guardian demon to those that worship Santaniel.

name: Leraje
description: A four eyed demon that licks its opponents to place them in a 100 year slumber.

name: Leviathan
description: So powerful that the Ultimate One trapped them in the Sea of Life to only release them at the end of time to swallow the Earth because of the sins of Humans.

name: Leyak
description: A holy demon that can withstand the effects of Holy Water.

name: Lili
description: A collection of demons that each possesses numerous influence over other demons in Hell, so much that they are higher in position of the Knights of Hell and close eyes to Santaniel while in his prison.

name: Lilith
description: The eldest daughter and wife to Santaniel. She was the product of Santaniel and Eve. When Eve left the Garden of Eden, so did her love for Santaniel. Lilith mended Santaniel’s once heavy heart and provided him with seven sons and two daughters.

name: Lix Tetrax
description: One of the earliest wives to Belckus before she was killed during his raid against Heaven, years before his son Santaniel did the same thing.

name: Lucifuge Rofocale
description: One of the Knights of Hell and modeled after Lucifer the angel of Heaven. He uses enhanced power to diffuge others. He rides on three black horsed led chariot that brings death behind it.

name: Malphas
description: The demon of energy that can omit negative energy against its opponents.

name: Mammon
description: One of the Knights of Hell and a powerful demon King. He once lived on Earth commanded armies stretching across centuries and took over most of the ancient world using different names.

name: Mara
description: A beautiful demoness that uses black magic to fight battles against her opponents and sometimes her allies. She is one of the first followers to Eve.

name: Marax
description: A fire demon of ancient origin. Its body is made up of rock and lava.

name: Marbas
description: A marbled demon with piercing eyes made of snow and ice.

name: Marchosias
description: A flower demon that uses nature to capture its opponents.

name: Maricha
description: A mimic demon that copies the powers of others.

name: Masih ad-Dajjal)
description: The demon of technology. She is strong and very intelligent. Her hair is hardwired to the circuits of the technology world above.

name: Mastema
description: A mischievous demon that can burn the souls of others by simply reaching into the body and ripping them out.

name: Mathim
description: A demon that uses math to torture men and women of Earth. He wears large bifocals that allows him to see into the souls of others.

name: Medusa
description: A gorgon and demon of Greek Mythology. She represents tortured souls on Earth. In Elitsyian Mythology, she is relatively spoken as a demon that can turn men to stone however, her powers has no effects on women and magical beings.

name: Mephistopheles
description: A demon guard that protects the hearts of those that has had their hearts ripped out while being tortured. The hearts are used later for spells.

name: Merihem
description: A mermaid demon that sits at the bottom of the sea eating other fish

name: Mictlantecuhtli
description: A seven headed demon and one of the Seven Princes’ of Hell. He laughs at the misfortunes of others and carries a sickle that tortures others by stabbing them in the gut.

name: Moloch
description: A mirror demon that can only come to the land of the living through the fifth seal being broken which is found in Antarctica and is guarded by the Demoy family. He rules over the Mirror World however is seen as a deity amongst the residence. He is also one of the Knights of Hell.

name: Murmur
description: A demon whose influence on earth is to cause heart related failures among humans and animals.

name: Naamah
description: The demon who tortures higher beings who have been sent to Hell. He uses a hacksaw and chainsaw as his weapons of choice.

name: Naberius
description: The guard dog to the gates of the tormented souls.

name: Naberus
description: A demon and one of the Seven Princes’ of Hell. He overthrew his brothers to take charge over the Army of Hell which was led against Heaven during the great war.

name: Naphula
description: A demonic witch that uses black magic to summon her fellow demons above ground. She is only allowed above ground at night, thus having sex with men allows her to roam during the day, although partially human with little control over her magical powers.

name: Nekomata
description: A demonic crab that takes the form of a woman to seduce men into the sea where her friends eat out their organs.

name: Neqa'el
description: The demon swamp dog that breathes in smoke and spits out rivers of lava.

name: Ninurta
description: Demon princess and once lover of her father Santaniel before she was banished for betraying their love after falling in love with her brother Naberus.

name: Nisroch
description: Knight of Hell, this clever demon uses his large swords to create huge wind storms that protects his region from intruders.

name: Nix
description: The demon of the night. Worshipped primarily in Greece. This demon moves the night alongside the flow of the day on the opposite parts of the world. She rides a chariot led by two large blue dogs.

name: Nyai Loro Kidul
description: A pink skinned demon with long flowing red hair. She is the most beautiful demon and is sought by many to birth demonic children. So far she has over 1 million children all lesser known demons serving part of the Belki.

name: Obizoth
description: A Knight of Hell that holds the Amulet of Psi which grants him power to cloak himself from anything including Santaniel. He worships Belckus and hopes to overthrow his fellow knights to become his first in command.

name: Oni
description: One of the Knights of Hell and contains enhanced knowledge of life before the fallen unlike many other demons. He raged war against Heaven in a private attempt to become a Seraphim.

name: Onoskelis
description: A muscled hardened demon that is of Greek origin. He speaks in multiple languages and help invent the demonic language that is shared in Hell.

name: Oray
description: One of the loyal followers to the Knights of Hell.

name: Orcus
description: A malevolent demon of godly proportions. His powers are so in depth that he is called on to perform powerful spells by both good and evil spell casters.

name: Oriax
description: Capable of seeing into many different times (past, present, and future) and into any world. It has no specific gender and its body is enclosed in a cape that omits dark energy.

name: Orobas
description: One of the Seven Princes’ of Hell. His large white body glows brilliantly when he powers up. He can cause storms by speaking.

name: Ose
description: The demonic deity that controls most of the northern part of the third level of Hell.

name: Paimon
description: A salmon demon that can swim very fast.

name: Pazuzu
description: A fat demon that will consume anything that comes near it.

name: Penemue
description: A demon that can call on other demons to form a big dragon like demon.

name: Phenex
description: A warrior demon with big black and white wings.

name: Pithius
description: A snake demon that uses its tail to squeeze the life out of its victims.

name: Pocong
description: A floating demon that houses a city on its back

name: Pontianak
description: A demon that lives beneath the sea. It cannot breathe air so it uses the ocean to drown its victims and eat them once under water.

name: Popobawa
description: A floating teddy bear like demon that can turn anything to life.

name: Psoglav
description: Note: Slavic mythology

name: Purson
description: A frog demon that uses its tongue to disperse acid

name: Putana
description: The monk turned demon, it sought enlightenment, however, when it was given, the monk prayed to the dead to grant it with powers to overthrow its monastery.

name: Rahab
description: Demon of food. It provides food poison

name: Rahovart
description: A demon that often comes out of Hell to cause havoc.

name: Raiju
description: A cat demon that changes colors and casts doubt on those that bypass it.

name: Rakshasa
description: A spider woman like demon that kills anyone in her web including her own children.

name: Rangda
description: A demon that provides curses to witches of black magic.

name: Raum

name: Vonus
description: A higher ranking demon who can see the future however, only destructive ones. He fell in love with Koniel, causing the two to be cast out of their respective realms. Koniel found himself in the home of the gods, Liumus. While he became a resident to the Shadow Realm.

name: The Ringer
description: Born in Hell, the Ringer is a mutilated man whose parents often left him alone at home much to the abuse by his siblings which his parents didn’t believe. One day he killed them in their sleep and was sent to Hell because his killings didn’t stop. He was brought back to life to continue his killing spree by an unknown demon. He has rings embedded in his skin mostly on his face. He uses those rings to slash his victims.

name: Halloween Killer
description: Bullied as a human, this spirit returns every Halloween to steal the soul of teenagers. With their souls it grows stronger, allowing it to remain in the mortal world for longer than one night. It has attracted much attention over the centuries even many referring to it as the Halloween Killer.

name: Ronald Hines “The Ugly Reaper”
description: Dressed in a pure white suit, Ronald Hines grew up rich and cared for. It was his growing attention to murdering women he deemed “ugly” and taking their eyes. Believing he could transform them into beautiful individuals.

name: Tommy “the 13th Killer” Rush
description: Living near a swamp, this serial killer appears to be mostly man with skin lathered by the harsh nature of his swamp home. Killed in a boating accident, Tommy Rush’s body was never recovered, and his mother later died attempting to solve his murder. Every Friday the 13th, Tommy “the 13th Killer” Rush began killing anyone out of sport with no obvious reason other than for enjoyment.

name: Night Nurse
description: A beautiful woman that serves as a nurse in a worn for wear hospital. Here she is a night nurse that takes the lives of children that many to be forgotten. Believing they will remain with her in their deaths keeping her company and reminding her of her once dead children that died in numerous ways.

name: Nightmare Man
description: Appearing in the nightmares of those with secrets. Son of Tonik, this creature was once a therapist that mastered in dream therapy to rid someone of their nightmares. One day, he died in his sleep and was reborn as the son of Tonik with the ability to continue his practice, however now instead of helping to rid someone of nightmares, he acts as the emissary of nightmares. Trapping people within them until they die. He is solely responsible for the rising population of Nigirakarte.

name: Kenneth “Oracle Reaper” Stone
description: A powerful psychic that has killed numerous children by abducting them and erasing the minds of their parents and/or guardians of their existence. He appeared in the late 1960s and has mostly gone unnoticed because of his abilities. He often keeps the children in a house that sits on top of a psychic vortex.

name: Chace “Dollface” Canes
description: A hateful spirit that can inhabit the forms of inanimate toys to lure children to their deaths. Once inhabiting said toys, he can walk, talk, and act on his own. His often form is a stuff bear and or toy resembling a boy or a girl.

name: Dr. Richard Himmith
description: Exiled from his practice for taking the lives of his patients when he believed to be lost causes. Dr. Richard Himmith and his assistant Registered Nurse Paula Downing continued their practice of taking lives of those they deemed lost causes throughout the country. They have still never been found with numerous failed reports. Their crimes happened mostly in the 1980s and 1990s.

name: Paula Downing
description: Registered Nurse Paula Downing is a beautiful country belle type of a woman that along with Dr. Richard Himmith committed over a hundred murders across the USA before disappearing in the early 2000s. They were never found and was believed to have died or been killed.

name: Jack the Ripper
description: A serial killer in the late 1800s, believed to have been a man, some believed them to be a woman, others believed it to be a demon. Most commonly Jack the Ripper was a serial killer that appeared in the shadows, attracting lonely women, and killing them leaving their bodies dismembered. Jack the Ripper disappeared shortly after the early 1900s.

name: Angel “Family Killing Spirit” Rodriguez
description: Usually seen wearing a cut out mask, Angel Rodriguez killed his family in their sleep before taking his own life. The reason for this was never known. He often returns from the grave near his old home to take the lives of other families, with many calling him the Family Killing Spirit.

name: Tokichi Uki
description: Tokichi Uki often uses poisonous gas to poison this victim. Born in Osaka, Japan, Tokichi would poison his victims and place their bodies on his wall rearranging their faces in cartoonish depictions.

name: Jerome Hattiwell
description: Jerome Hattiwell was a brilliant AI developer that built an algorithm that could trap anyone wearing a VR device into a fictional world of his control. Throughout his crime spree, he trapped over 100,000 in his virtual world in a worldwide panic that led to his suicide, trapping himself inside of his world of his own rule. This moment in time became known as the Digital Murder and was the largest of its kind in history. The victims would later die in the real world and Jerome’s software and numerous VR devices were banned. This crime took place in the year 2100 to 2115.

name: Unit 666
description: A crime organization that houses over 3,000 serial killers with numerous alias’. While they have never been found, they operate in plain site as large corporations with normal appearing conventions all around the world. Their growing organization provides money, missions, and even games to serial killers to carry out events. By the year 2050, this organization is responsible for about 97% of killings in the world.
